styles.not: Not decorative, not symmetrical, not soft; no gradients, no rounded friendly shapes, no third colour, no real political emblems (no hammer-and-sickle, no star), no neat central alignment.
styles.render: Three inks on cream: #f2e8cf ground, #1d1d1b and #d62828, plus one grey #6c757d. One hard diagonal (about -22 deg) organises everything: the black band, the red band and the type's baseline all sit on it or cross it at 90 deg, and every shape is a polygon with knife edges (clip-path, no radius above 4 px). The figure is built only from blocks - a circle head, a trapezoid torso, tapered-rectangle limbs - in flat silhouette, never an outline drawing. Photomontage is faked with an SVG <pattern> of 3.4 px ink dots on a 12 px grid (a halftone photo block), holding a second, smaller silhouette or a city of stacked rectangles. Type is a filled block: Anton at 240-320 px rotated on the diagonal, one word per line, with a letterspaced Montserrat line counter-rotated 90 deg against it; cream text is only ever knocked out of a black band, never laid over the red.
styles.composition: Off-balance, poster-like: a huge tilted word in the top third, a figure striding on the diagonal in the middle, a halftone block cut by the frame edge, one red field large enough to be a third of the picture, and a diagonal of empty cream left as breathing room.
styles.colour: Cream #f2e8cf paper, black #1d1d1b, poster red #d62828, grey #6c757d for the halftone only; red and black never touch a gradient, and the red is always one flat area, not an accent outline.
styles.type: Anton caps, one word, rotated -8 to -12 deg, tight leading, filling a third of the width; Montserrat 700 caps with 0.2 em tracking for the small counter-rotated line; cream knocked out of black for the secondary text.
styles.motion: Hard and abrupt: shapes slide in on the diagonal in 0.25-0.35 s with power4.out and stop dead; the type stamps on with one frame of overshoot; no fade-ins longer than 0.3 s, no easing that lingers.
styles.camera: Locked, frontal, poster-flat; a single whip-pan on the diagonal, or a fast 1.08 push that lands on the tilted word.
styles.transitions: A diagonal wipe at the composition's own angle; a black band that slams across and becomes the next scene's ground; hard cut on the beat.
styles.sound: Industrial and dry: a metal clang, a pneumatic press, a snare hit, a male voice choir on one long note, typewriter keys; no melody under it.

tr.look: Sovyet afişi: krem kâğıt, kırmızı-siyah, sert diyagonaller, geometrik bloklardan figür, tramlı fotoğraf bloğu, eğik dev yazı.
tr.type: Anton, tek kelime, diyagonalle eğik; karşısında ince aralıklı küçük satır.
tr.motion: Sert ve ani: şekiller diyagonal üzerinde kayar ve durur; yazı bir kare taşar.
tr.sound: Metal vuruş, pres, trampet, tek notada koro.
tr.avoid: Yumuşak geçiş, simetri, üçüncü renk, gerçek siyasi sembol, yuvarlak hat.

en.look: Soviet poster: cream paper, red and black, hard diagonals, a figure of geometric blocks, a halftone photo block, huge tilted type.
en.type: Anton, one word, tilted on the diagonal; a thin tracked line across it.
en.motion: Hard and abrupt: shapes slide on the diagonal and stop dead; type overshoots one frame.
en.sound: Metal clang, press, snare, a choir on one note.
en.avoid: Soft transitions, symmetry, a third colour, real political emblems, rounded shapes.

styles.name: Linocut print
styles.essence: A relief print pulled from a carved lino block: heavy black shapes cut open by white gouges, one spot colour, chunky irregular edges and patches where the ink did not take.
styles.not: Not a smooth vector silhouette, not a pencil sketch, not greyscale; no gradients, no hairline under 3 px, no soft shadow, no tidy registration.
styles.render: Black #111 on cream #f4ede1, plus ONE spot ink (#c1272d or #e9b44c). Every black shape is a chunky filled path, its outline pushed through <filter><feTurbulence baseFrequency='.02' numOctaves='3'/><feDisplacementMap scale='7'/></filter> so no edge is machine-straight; the spot colour is the same shape printed 6-10 px off register. Form is described only by CARVED WHITE: tapered slivers (a path with one pointed end, cream fill, no stroke) following the volume, plus parallel gouges of 4-8 px at 25-40 deg that get denser in the shadow; keep at least a 6 px gap so the black still reads as one mass. Uneven ink is a second pass of 8-12 cream blotches at .12-.25 opacity, displaced by the same filter and clipped to the black shape, so the block looks hand-pulled and slightly starved. Paper stays bare where the block was cut away - never a grey tint.
styles.composition: One animal or figure filling the middle third, a single spot-colour disc behind it, a black ground band cut with grass gouges at the bottom, the headline huge in the upper left; generous bare paper between them.
styles.colour: Black #111111, paper #f4ede1, one accent #c1272d (or ochre #e9b44c); the accent is a flat disc or a single garment, printed slightly out of register, never an outline.
styles.type: Anton caps, very large, letterspaced 0.02 em, in the black ink, edges as rough as the block; a small line in Inter Tight 500 if a second line is needed.
styles.motion: Stop-motion on twos: shapes appear whole in 2-3 frames with one 1.5% overshoot and a 2-4 px settle, as if a print were stamped; long holds, nothing glides.
styles.camera: Locked; a slow 1.06 push into the black mass, or a 2 px drift as if the paper were being positioned under the press.
styles.transitions: A gouge line sweeps and becomes the next horizon; a black shape stamps down and covers the frame; the spot colour registers in from one side.
styles.sound: Wooden and dry: a press thump, a gouge scraping lino, a frame drum, a low male hum, paper sliding on a table.

tr.look: Linol baskı: krem kâğıtta ağır siyah formlar, beyaz oyma çizgileriyle açılmış, tek vurgu rengi, pürüzlü kenarlar, eksik mürekkep lekeleri.
tr.type: Anton, çok büyük, pürüzlü kenarlı.
tr.motion: İki karede bir: baskı gibi damgalanır, tek küçük oturma; uzun duraklamalar.
tr.sound: Pres gümbürtüsü, oyma sesi, çerçeve davul, kâğıt.
tr.avoid: Gradyan, ince çizgi, gri ton, yumuşak gölge, düzgün vektör silüet.

en.look: Linocut: heavy black masses on cream, opened by white gouges, one spot colour, rough edges, starved-ink patches.
en.type: Anton, very large, rough edges.
en.motion: On twos: stamps down like a pulled print, one small settle, long holds.
en.sound: Press thump, gouge scrape, frame drum, paper.
en.avoid: Gradients, thin lines, greys, soft shadows, tidy vector silhouettes.

styles.name: Cyanotype print
styles.essence: A sun print: botanical specimens lying on paper coated in iron salts, exposed to light and washed - deep Prussian blue where the light fell, pale cream silhouettes where the plant blocked it, the brush marks of the coating still visible at the edges.
styles.not: Not a blue-tinted photo, not a flat navy background with white clip-art; no outlines, no warm accent colour, no pure white, no drop shadows, no paper border strip.
styles.render: Two values only: a Prussian blue field #0a2d4d with pools of #114b75 / #1c5a86 and a pale cream #f3f0e4 negative, no third hue anywhere. The blue is a <rect> pushed through <filter><feTurbulence baseFrequency='.008 .012' numOctaves='2'/><feDisplacementMap scale='40'/></filter> so its outer edge wanders like a brush-loaded sheet, then 6-10 very large blurred ellipses (blur 60-90 px, .12-.3 alpha) mottle the coating. Specimens are flat cream paths with a 3-5 px displacement wobble of their own: a fern as 10-12 mirrored leaflet ellipses on a tapering stem, a leaf as two mirrored bezier halves, a flower as 8 rotated petal ellipses; every form is 0.86-0.95 alpha so where two overlap the cream thickens. Inside the pale forms, cut back in with blue 2-6 px lines for veins, midribs and petal folds - the plant shows through as thin blue, never as an outline. Fade some forms to .35-.55 to read as specimens laid at different depths.
styles.composition: A herbarium arrangement: one tall fern on the centre line, a broad leaf and a flower at either side, a few loose sprigs, all overlapping loosely inside the frame rather than in a neat row; the headline small and quiet in the top left, with empty blue above and below.
styles.colour: Prussian blue #0a2d4d, its exposure pools #114b75 and #1c5a86, pale cream #f3f0e4, and the pale blue #75b6cf only as veins inside the silhouettes; no warm colour at all.
styles.type: Cormorant Garamond 300 or Instrument Serif, 90-130 px, cream, wide letterspacing, sentence case with a small Inter Tight caps line under it; place it as if written on the negative, never with a shadow.
styles.motion: Slow exposure: forms bloom in at .4-.6 alpha and settle, the blue field breathes up from 0.9 to full, veins draw on over 1 s; all sine easing, nothing snaps.
styles.camera: A very slow push in on the specimens, or a pan across the sheet as if the print were being lifted to the light.
styles.transitions: The next frame develops through, cream first and blue after; a soft wash of blue sweeps the frame and hardens; a specimen's silhouette grows until it is the whole frame.
styles.sound: Quiet and aqueous: water being poured, a soft paper peel, a low drone, a distant bird, a single struck glass.

tr.look: Siyanotip: Prusya mavisi kâğıtta bitkilerin krem siluetleri, fırça izli kenarlar, üst üste binen saydam yapraklar.
tr.type: İnce serif, geniş aralıklı, mavi negatifin üstünde krem.
tr.motion: Yavaş pozlama: formlar belirir, damarlar çizilir; hiçbir şey sıçramaz.
tr.sound: Su, kâğıt, alçak drone, uzak kuş.
tr.avoid: Sıcak renk, kontur, saf beyaz, mavi tonlu fotoğraf, gölge.

en.look: Cyanotype: cream silhouettes of plants on Prussian blue, brushed edges, translucent overlaps.
en.type: Thin serif, wide tracked, cream on the blue negative.
en.motion: Slow exposure: forms bloom in, veins draw on; nothing snaps.
en.sound: Water, paper, low drone, a distant bird.
en.avoid: Warm colour, outlines, pure white, blue-tinted photos, shadows.

styles.name: Manga screentone
styles.essence: Black and white manga: clean ink contours of varying weight, shadows laid in as screentone dot patterns or solid black, radiating speed lines, and panels cut by a hard black border.
styles.not: Not grayscale airbrush, not anime cel colour, no soft gradients, no speech balloons, no photorealism, no grey fills where a dot screen belongs.
styles.render: White paper, one ink: #0d0d0d. Contours are paths with a deliberately uneven weight - 10-14 px on the outside of a silhouette, 3-5 px for details - and closed, never broken. Shadow is a SCREEN, not a tint: an SVG <pattern> of black circles r 2.6 on a 9 px grid rotated 45 deg (a second, coarser r 4.5 / 14 px for large areas) clipped to the shaded shape, plus solid black for the deepest core; a mid tone only ever appears as dots. Speed lines are 40-70 hairlines (2-4 px) radiating from a point behind the subject, drawn from radius 260 out to the frame edge with irregular lengths and a few gaps, densest at the edges. Panels: 8-10 px solid black borders with a 24-40 px white gutter, one wide panel and one narrow one, the subject breaking the border on one side only. Impact marks (a few tapered spikes) are allowed at the frame edge.
styles.composition: Portrait, low angle: the face fills the lower panel, the hair breaking the top border, the headline in the narrow panel above; open white gutter between them and the speed lines bursting from behind the head.
styles.colour: Black #0d0d0d on white #ffffff, one flat grey #7a7a7a only as a dot screen, and at most one #d90429 accent on the single object that matters.
styles.type: Anton or Poppins 700 for the title, set as if hand-lettered inside the panel with a slight italic lean; small Inter Tight caps for a caption strip knocked out of black.
styles.motion: On twos, decisive: panels slam in with a 1-frame black flash, speed lines flicker between two seeded sets, the face holds dead still; a sudden 1.06 snap on the impact.
styles.camera: Manga camera: a low-angle push into the eyes, a hard cut between panels, a whip pan that leaves speed lines behind.
styles.transitions: A panel border slams in and becomes the next frame; speed lines wipe across; a white flash on the beat.
styles.sound: Ink and impact: brush on paper, a paper slap, a taiko hit on the reveal, a single distorted guitar stab, silence between.

tr.look: Siyah beyaz manga: değişken kalınlıkta mürekkep konturlar, tram noktalı gölgeler, hız çizgileri, panel kenarları.
tr.type: Elle yazılmış gibi Anton başlık, panelin içinde.
tr.motion: İki karede bir: paneller çarparak girer, hız çizgileri titreşir, yüz hareketsiz.
tr.sound: Fırça, kâğıt şaklaması, taiko, tek gitar vuruşu.
tr.avoid: Gri hava fırçası, renkli sel, konuşma balonu, yumuşak gradyan.

en.look: Black and white manga: ink contours of varying weight, screentone shadows, speed lines, panel borders.
en.type: Anton title set like hand lettering inside the panel.
en.motion: On twos: panels slam in, speed lines flicker, the face holds still.
en.sound: Brush, paper slap, taiko, one guitar stab.
en.avoid: Grey airbrush, cel colour, speech balloons, soft gradients.

styles.name: Art Nouveau
styles.essence: A Mucha lithograph: a woman in three-quarter view inside a mosaic arch and a beaded halo, her long hair uncoiling into whiplash curls, stylised lilies climbing the border, flat muted tones sealed by one uniform brown line.
styles.not: Not a children's-book drawing, not big-eyed cartoon faces, not a plain rectangular photo frame, not bright saturated colour, no shadows or gradients on the figure, no photoreal rendering.
styles.render: One SVG (1080x1920), CURVES ONLY: every stem, lock and fold is a cubic bezier that ends by curling back on itself, no path straight for more than 40 px, all outlines ONE brown #5e3f2b - 6-10 px on the outside of the figure, 2.5-4 px for features - and each material one flat tone, never a gradient. The halo is a flat cream disc r 300 with two thin rings and a row of 26 gold beads; behind it an ARCH (semicircle r 340 on two straight legs) filled as MOSAIC: four concentric bands of flat gold, cream and terracotta, cut into tiles by 13 radial rules from the arc centre and two horizontal rules down the legs, clipped to the arch, every tile edge 5 px brown. The figure is a bust drawn anatomically: three-quarter head (nose line, heavy-lidded almond eyes, small bowed mouth with a #c97967 lower lip), a long neck with a shadow under the jaw, bare sloping shoulders and upper arms, a small gold pendant, and a sage gown whose gold neckline follows a sweetheart curve with a row of terracotta dots; folds are 2.5 px brown lines. Hair is 5 closed whiplash masses in #a05f36 with 2 px strand lines and separate spiral curls that end in a hook. Lilies are 6 tepals (two whorls of 3, 60 deg apart) as pointed bezier shields with a centre vein, 5 stamen lines with dots; leaves are paired teardrops. The border is a thin brown double rule with lily stems climbing over it and three big lilies across the bottom.
styles.composition: Vertical poster, centre-heavy but never symmetrical: the title in wide-tracked serif caps in the paper above the arch, the arch filling the middle two thirds, the figure a half-length bust inside it - head in the halo, bare shoulders above the gold neckline of the gown - hair falling to both sides and sweeping right, three lilies and their whiplash stems along the bottom edge cutting the gown, small lilies climbing both side margins.
styles.colour: Cream #f4f1de ground, gold #e0b96a with #f0d79a, sage #8fa886 with #b3c4a8, dusty terracotta #d08a75 with #e0a48c, skin #ecc9a2 with #d9a97e, hair #a05f36, one outline brown #5e3f2b; each material one flat tone and at most one darker line.
styles.type: Cormorant Garamond 300 caps with 0.3 em tracking for the title, small gold-brown #8a6a3b sitting above the arch like a dedication; a smaller italic line beneath in #5e3f2b.
styles.motion: Curves grow, they never slide: the arch tiles fade in band by band, the halo blooms in scale, hair curls draw on 0.8 s after the face, lilies unfurl last. Nothing bounces, nothing snaps.
styles.camera: Slow and lyrical: a 1.06 push on the face, a vertical drift up a stem, a slight parallax between the ornament and the figure.
styles.transitions: A stem spiral unwinds into the next scene's line; the halo grows to fill the frame; a petal wipe.
styles.sound: Harp, muted strings, a solo flute, a soft cymbal swell; a warm room reverb, nothing percussive.

tr.look: Mucha gibi: mozaik kemer ve boncuklu hâle içinde üç çeyrek figür, kamçı gibi kıvrılan saç, zambak bordürü, tek kahve kontur, düz yumuşak renkler.
tr.type: Küçük, geniş aralıklı serif büyük harfler; kemerin üstünde bir ithaf gibi.
tr.motion: Eğriler büyür, kaymaz; saç yüzden bir vuruş sonra yerleşir.
tr.sound: Arp, yaylılar, flüt, yumuşak zil.
tr.avoid: Dikdörtgen çerçeve, simetri, sert köşe, parlak renk, çocuk kitabı yüzü.

en.look: Mucha-like: a three-quarter figure in a mosaic arch and a beaded halo, hair uncoiling in whiplash curls, a lily border, one brown outline, flat muted tones.
en.type: Small wide-tracked serif caps, above the arch like a dedication.
en.motion: Curves grow, never slide; the hair settles a beat after the face.
en.sound: Harp, muted strings, flute, soft cymbal.
en.avoid: Rectangular frames, symmetry, hard corners, bright colour, children's-book faces.

styles.name: Cave painting
styles.essence: Pigment on a rock wall by firelight: ochre and charcoal animals drawn with crude confidence, hand stencils blown around a palm, uneven coverage where the rock drinks the paint, no outlines that close cleanly.
styles.not: Not a clean vector animal, not a museum illustration, no black line-art on white, no smooth gradients, no modern objects, no neat rows.
styles.render: Two pigments only: ochre #8b3a1f / #c47a3d and charcoal #2b2018, every mark at .55-.9 alpha so the rock #d9c3a0 shows through and doubles the colour. The wall is the whole frame: a base #d9c3a0 with 6-9 huge blurred blotches (#a88b6a, #6e4b32, #c9b590; blur 80-160, .18-.4) and 3-4 thin dark crack lines wandering across it. Animals are built from 3-6 crude primitives (a body ellipse, a hump ellipse, a wedge head, four tapered legs, a whip tail) welded into one group and pushed through <filter><feTurbulence baseFrequency='.012' numOctaves='3'/><feDisplacementMap scale='14'/></filter>, so every edge crumbles; the fill is flat ochre with a few darker strokes where pigment pooled. A second animal is charcoal outline only, 6-10 px, broken by the rock. Hand stencils are negative: a sprayed ochre ellipse (blur 12, turbulence) masked <mask> by a black hand path so the palm stays bare rock. Humans are 3-5 stroke tapered stick figures, slightly too small beside the animals. Scatter 8-12 finger dots in a row, never in a line.
styles.composition: A frieze, not a poster: the big animal off-centre and low, a smaller one higher and to the side, stencilled hands at the frame edges, tiny hunters beside the herd, no horizon and no sky - the wall is the whole world. Empty rock is part of the image.
styles.colour: Rock #d9c3a0 with blotches #a88b6a / #6e4b32, ochre #8b3a1f and #c47a3d, charcoal #2b2018; pigment is always translucent enough that the stone changes it.
styles.type: Cormorant Garamond 700 or Instrument Serif in caps, charcoal #2b2018, edges pushed through the same turbulence so the lettering looks painted with a finger; small, low in the frame, never centred.
styles.motion: Painted, not animated: marks appear like a hand passing over the rock (a 0.4-0.6 s reveal with a 2-3 px displacement wobble that settles), the firelight brightens and dims the whole frame slowly, nothing slides.
styles.camera: Locked to the wall; a very slow push that makes the rock grain crawl, or a firelight flicker as the only movement.
styles.transitions: A hand shadow sweeps across the wall; the next pigment bleeds in from one edge; a cut as the fire flares.
styles.sound: Fire, dripping water, a low bone flute, breath, a struck stone; deep reverb like a cave.

tr.look: Mağara duvarında aşı boyası ve kömür: kaba ama kararlı hayvanlar, avuç çevresine üflenmiş el şablonları, düzensiz pigment.
tr.type: Parmakla yazılmış gibi pürüzlü büyük harfler, kömür rengi.
tr.motion: Boyalı, animasyonlu değil: izler belirir, ateş ışığı kareyi yavaşça aydınlatır.
tr.sound: Ateş, damlayan su, kemik flüt, taş vuruşu, derin yankı.
tr.avoid: Temiz vektör, siyah kontur, beyaz zemin, düz gradyan, modern nesne.

en.look: Ochre and charcoal on a cave wall: crude confident animals, hand stencils blown around a palm, uneven pigment.
en.type: Rough painted caps in charcoal, as if by finger.
en.motion: Painted, not animated: marks appear, firelight slowly lifts the frame.
en.sound: Fire, dripping water, bone flute, struck stone, deep reverb.
en.avoid: Clean vectors, black line art, white ground, flat gradients, modern objects.

styles.name: Steel engraving
styles.essence: A 19th-century banknote plate: nothing is filled, every tone is a family of burin lines and their spacing alone builds the light, cut in sepia-black into cream paper, with the banknote's guilloche rosette and rule frame.
styles.not: Not a sepia photo filter, not a flat vector shape with an outline, not a pencil drawing; no solid grey or tonal fills, no gradient shading, no soft shadows, no halftone dots, no colour beyond sepia ink.
styles.render: Ink #221a12 on cream #efe6d2, plus its dilutions #6a5138 and #a98d67 - no third hue, no fill anywhere. Every area is ONE <path> holding many subpaths (`M..h..` per line) with stroke-width 1.2-2.2 so a whole family is a single node: sky = fine horizontals at pitch 7-8, crowded to 4.5 near the horizon and wiped away by a <mask> whose radial gradient covers the rosette; any cylinder (tower, hull, trunk) = verticals at x = cx + half*sin(theta) so the lines crowd at the silhouette and open in the middle, plus TWO crossing families on the shadow side (60-70 deg and -35 deg) at pitch 2.6-3.4 that run close to solid. Add tapered burin spindles (a lens-shaped filled path with a point at each end, 60-260 px long) over the shadow side so the strokes swell in the middle and taper out. The value range runs from bare paper white to near-black line-mass: the darkest sides of the tower, the islet, the hull and the foreground water carry pitch 1.4-2.4. Sea = tight horizontals at pitch 3-4 with a wavy swell family over them and vertical squiggle reflections under the subject; hills and rocks = two crosshatched families at -25 and 40 deg at pitch 3. Highlights are the plate wiped back to paper (paper-colour strokes), never white paint. Banknote furniture: a guilloche rosette of 16 nested parametric rings (r = R + a*sin(k*theta)) that also serves as the sun, a double rule frame, tiny engraved caps. Push line groups through <filter><feTurbulence baseFrequency='.02' numOctaves='2'/><feDisplacementMap scale='1.6'/></filter> so no line is machine-straight.
styles.composition: One tower on its islet on the centre line, the guilloche rosette burning in the sky behind its crown, ruled water filling the lower third, the Asia shore a thin hatched strip at the horizon, a caique low on the left, the headline stacked in the upper left and the rule frame closing the plate.
styles.colour: Cream #efe6d2, burin black-brown #221a12, warm sepia #6a5138, pale washed sepia #a98d67; every 'grey' is a line pitch of those inks, never a mixed flat.
styles.type: DM Serif Display 400 caps, 130-160 px, stacked and letterspaced .01 em, in the ink; a small Inter Tight 500 caps line at .3 em under it, and 22 px engraved caps inside the frame if a date or place is needed.
styles.motion: The plate is bitten in: line families fade up in the order an engraver would cut them, sky then hills then water then the tower, each with a .3-.5 s dissolve and no movement at all; the rosette's rings draw on with stroke-dashoffset; text comes up .2 s after the sky. Nothing drifts, nothing scales.
styles.camera: Locked, like a note under a magnifier: at most a 1.05 push toward the tower or a 3 px drift of the whole plate.
styles.transitions: A line family sweeps across and becomes the next horizon; the plate is wiped to paper and the next drawing is bitten in; the frame closes in to the rosette.
styles.sound: Dry and precise: a burin scratching copper, a press roller, a paper rustle, a single low string, a distant gull; no reverb bloom.

tr.look: Çelik gravür: hiç dolgu yok, her ton çizgi sıklığıyla; sepya mürekkep krem kâğıtta, banknot gülü ve ince çerçeve.
tr.type: DM Serif Display büyük harf, hafif aralıklı; altında küçük aralıklı sans.
tr.motion: Plaka oyulur gibi: çizgi grupları sırayla belirir, hiçbir şey kaymaz.
tr.sound: Kalem cızırtısı, pres, kâğıt, tek alçak yaylı, uzak martı.
tr.avoid: Dolgu, gri ton, gradyan, yumuşak gölge, halftone nokta, sepya foto filtre.

en.look: Steel engraving: no fills, tone only from line pitch; sepia ink on cream, banknote rosette and a fine rule frame.
en.type: DM Serif Display caps, lightly tracked; a small tracked sans beneath.
en.motion: Bitten into the plate: line families come up in cutting order, nothing drifts.
en.sound: Burin scratch, press roller, paper, one low string, a distant gull.
en.avoid: Fills, greys, gradients, soft shadows, halftone dots, sepia photo filters.

styles.name: Watercolour
styles.essence: Wet paint on cold-pressed paper: translucent washes that bloom into each other, a darker ring where the pigment dried at the edge, granulation in the shadow, and the white of the paper left unpainted as the only light.
styles.not: Not flat vector colour, not a digital painting with an airbrush, not sumi ink (that is ink_wash); no hard outlines, no opaque white paint, no gradients that shade smoothly, no drop shadows.
styles.render: Paper #fbf6ea carries all light: never paint it, only leave it. Build the value structure in three steps - a light graded sky of 3-4 broad horizontal band washes (#6f8ea3 at .08-.15, warm ochre bleeding in near the horizon), mid-tone buildings in ochre #cf8f44 and rose #c0644f at .3-.4, then only a handful of near-dark accents (indigo #2f4b63 to #1d2b36 at .55-.8) in windows, cap, trousers, shoes and cast shadow. Every wash is a closed blob path (a closed quadratic chain of 10-14 jittered points) and each one is painted four times: the fill at .3-.6 alpha, a mottle of the same hue (a 380 px <pattern> of soft radial blotches at .18-.3, so no wash is one even colour), a granulation speckle (a 26 px pattern of 1-3 px dots at .1-.2), and the dried edge - the same path stroked 10-18 px in a deeper ink at .25-.4, clipped INSIDE the shape and broken with an irregular stroke-dasharray and a 8 px turbulence displacement, so the pigment ring appears in patches and reads as a hard dried edge, never as an outline. Group the big washes behind <filter><feTurbulence baseFrequency='.008' numOctaves='2'/><feDisplacementMap scale='34'/><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation='2.4'/></filter>; the figure behind a tighter one (baseFrequency .02, scale 6, blur .7) so its edges wander as water but the drawing stays readable. Paint the figure with the SAME washes as the background - no opaque fills: a white shirt and apron are unpainted paper with two translucency shadow washes clipped inside their shape, trousers are a wash at .55 with a darker fold wash, skin a single ochre-pink wash with a rose cheek. Leave white gaps cutting into every wash as highlights, and add 3-4 isolated blooms / cauliflowers (a pale lifted disc inside a hard dark ragged ring) in the sky and on the ground. Final dry-brush accents: 6-10 short strokes at .5-.7 with ragged ends.
styles.composition: A simit seller with a tall mound of simits on a brass tray on his head, standing full figure on the sunny corner of an Istanbul street, slightly right of centre; an ochre building with dark windows on the left and a rose building with an awning on the right frame a slice of pale graded sky with a distant mosque and minaret; the street fills the lower quarter, the cast shadow stretching left, the headline in the upper left where the paper is still white.
styles.colour: Indigo #2f4b63 and its pale #6f8ea3, warm ochre #cf8f44, faded rose #c0644f, olive grey #6d7f63, skin #e9b98f; all of it translucent so the paper's cream shows through every wash, the buildings warm and mid-toned, the few darks concentrated in the figure and the windows, and where two washes cross the tone deepens instead of mixing flat.
styles.type: Cormorant Garamond 600 caps, 120-150 px, letterspaced .02 em, in indigo, as if lettered with a brush; a small Inter Tight 500 caps line at .26 em under it in ochre-brown.
styles.motion: Paint arrives wet: each wash blooms up from .82 scale and .4 alpha to full over .6-.9 s with a slight settle, the pigment ring sharpening last; blooms spread open; brush accents appear in one stroke. All sine easing, nothing slides or snaps.
styles.camera: Locked on the paper; a very slow 1.05 push on the figure, or a drift as if the sheet were being turned to the light.
styles.transitions: A wash floods the frame and the next scene develops inside it; the paper is blotted and a new drawing appears; a bloom opens until it is the whole frame.
styles.sound: Water, a wet brush on rough paper, a distant street, a light nay or clarinet phrase, one soft chime; room tone rather than music.

tr.look: Sulu boya: kâğıdın beyazı ışığı taşır, saydam yıkamalar birbirine akar, kenarda pigment halkası, gölgede granülasyon.
tr.type: Cormorant Garamond büyük harf, fırçayla yazılmış gibi; altında küçük aralıklı sans.
tr.motion: Boya ıslak gelir: yıkamalar açılıp oturur, halka en son keskinleşir; hiçbir şey kaymaz.
tr.sound: Su, ıslak fırça, uzak sokak, tek ney cümlesi, yumuşak çıngırak.
tr.avoid: Düz vektör renk, hava fırçası, sert kontur, opak beyaz, pürüzsüz gradyan, gölge.

en.look: Watercolour: the paper's white carries the light, translucent washes bleed into each other, a pigment ring at the edge, granulation in shadow.
en.type: Cormorant Garamond caps, lettered like a brush; a small tracked sans beneath.
en.motion: Paint arrives wet: washes open and settle, the ring sharpens last; nothing slides.
en.sound: Water, a wet brush, a distant street, one nay phrase, a soft chime.
en.avoid: Flat vector colour, airbrush, hard outlines, opaque white, smooth gradients, shadows.

styles.name: Gouache poster
styles.essence: Opaque gouache brushed flat: matte, chalky colour laid in solid poster shapes, where every edge is a brush's edge, light is painted over dark, and the whole surface is dry and evenly dull - a mid-century travel poster made with a loaded brush.
styles.not: Not watercolour (nothing is translucent or blooming), not vector flat-design, not screen print; no gradients, no glow, no soft blur, no visible canvas or gloss, no outline drawing.
styles.render: Opaque and matte: no gradient anywhere, each field a single flat #hex at full alpha. Build each shape as three passes: an under-shape of the same path translated 5-8 px in a DARKER tint (the paint's own shadow edge), the flat colour on top, then 10-20 bristle streaks (6-10 px lines at 5-24 deg, clipped to the shape, .28-.4 alpha of a 6 % lighter or darker tint) and one 16-18 px white stroke at .16 along the loaded edge so the brush drag is visible; every shape sits in one <g> under <filter><feTurbulence baseFrequency='.008' numOctaves='3'/><feDisplacementMap scale='11'/></filter> so its contour is cut by hand. Light is painted over dark: the dark ink skyline goes down first, then the hull, the deck and the window rows land on top and leave a dark seam. Break colour at the edges only where the brush ran out: 6-10 short dry 3 px strokes in the paper colour along an edge. Keep at most six colours, mixed warm (ochre, vermilion) against one cold (teal), all at the same chalky value so nothing glows.
styles.composition: A Bosphorus ferry broadside in the middle band, its red funnel crossing the sky; flat sea filling the bottom third with three cream wave shapes; the city as a low ink silhouette on the horizon; a matte mustard sun disc high right; the headline in caps at the upper left and one small departure line under it.
styles.colour: Cream #f3e7cd, deep teal #1f4e5f, vermilion #d1503a, mustard #e3a13c, sage #9cb3a6, ink #16242c; every field flat, adjacent colours close in value so the poster reads calm rather than loud.
styles.type: Anton caps 150-200 px, tight, in ink or cream, flat, no shadow; a small Inter Tight 500 caps line at .3 em in vermilion under it.
styles.motion: Painted in flat: each shape lands whole in two frames, then a 6-10 px brush drag settles it (0.25 s); the wave shapes advance in steps, the ferry holds still. No fades on the shapes, no scaling, no floating.
styles.camera: Locked poster frame; at most a 1.04 push on the funnel or a 4 px slide as if the sheet were being squared up.
styles.transitions: A brush stroke of flat colour sweeps the frame and becomes the next sky; a shape is painted over the old scene; the poster is wiped with a rag.
styles.sound: Dry and matte: a ferry horn, a brush on board, a low bowed string, water slapping a hull, seagulls far off.

tr.look: Guaj boya: opak, mat, düz poster renkleri; her kenar fırça izi, açık koyunun üstüne boyanmış, yüzey kuru ve tozlu.
tr.type: Anton büyük harf, düz, gölgesiz; altında küçük aralıklı sans.
tr.motion: Düz boyanır: şekil iki karede bütün olarak gelir, sonra fırça 6-10 px sürüklenip oturur.
tr.sound: Vapur düdüğü, tahtaya fırça, alçak yaylı, su şapırtısı, uzak martı.
tr.avoid: Saydamlık, gradyan, parlama, kontur çizimi, vektör düzlük, kanvas doku.

en.look: Gouache: opaque matte poster colour, every edge a brush edge, light painted over dark, the surface dry and chalky.
en.type: Anton caps, flat, no shadow; a small tracked sans beneath.
en.motion: Painted flat: a shape lands whole in two frames, then a 6-10 px brush drag settles it.
en.sound: Ferry horn, brush on board, low strings, water on a hull, gulls far off.
en.avoid: Transparency, gradients, glow, outline drawing, vector flatness, canvas texture.

styles.name: Oil impasto
styles.essence: Thick oil paint pushed on with a loaded brush: every form is a heap of short directional strokes whose ridges catch the light, colour is broken into warm and cool flecks laid side by side, and the canvas weave shows between them.
styles.not: Not smooth airbrushed shading, not a flat vector shape, not watercolour transparency, not photorealism; no gradients, no soft blur, no outlines, no even single-colour fills.
styles.render: Build the whole picture from 450-600 short loaded strokes and nothing else - no base fill is ever seen. Each stroke is a <path> drawn as one quadratic curve with stroke-width 12-30, stroke-linecap round, and it is painted twice: the body in its own colour, then a ridge 2-4 px to one side in a colour 18-30 % lighter at .4-.6 alpha, so the paint looks raised and catches light from the upper left (a thin darker echo 3 px to the other side sells the thickness). Direction is a flow field, not random: sky strokes run nearly horizontal with a slow arc, sea strokes horizontal and shorter near the horizon, the tower's strokes vertical and crowded at its silhouette, the roof's strokes radial from the apex, grass strokes upward. Colour is BROKEN: each region owns 4-6 neighbouring hues and each stroke is picked from them by position plus 10 % chance of its complement (a warm ochre fleck in the cool sea), and neighbouring strokes are never the same value - no field is one colour. Ground is a canvas weave: an 8 px <pattern> of crossing 1.4 px threads at #b9a583 under everything, visible at the edges and in thin passages.
styles.composition: A lighthouse on a rocky headland right of centre, its tower catching the last warm light, sea filling the lower third in long horizontal strokes with the reflection broken underneath, the sky a broken field of cool greys above and warm ochre at the horizon; headline in the calm upper left over the palest sky.
styles.colour: Cool sky greys #9fb0bd / #b9c6cf over warm cream #e7d3b4 and ochre #e0a96d at the horizon; sea in #2e4a56 / #3a5866 / #5d7f85 with warm flecks #b98a5e; rock #4a3f36 / #6b5a4a; the tower's lit side #f0e3c9 against #a89c86; roof #8c4a3a.
styles.type: Playfair Display 700 caps, 130-160 px, in deep slate #2a3a44, slightly open; a small Inter Tight 500 caps line at .3 em underneath in the ochre.
styles.motion: The canvas is painted on: groups of strokes arrive in broad passes of .4-.6 s (sky, then rock, then tower, then sea), each pass wiping in from one side while its strokes stay perfectly still; nothing scales or floats after it lands.
styles.camera: Locked as if on an easel; a slow 1.05 push toward the tower, or a drift that shows the weave at the edge.
styles.transitions: A loaded brush drags across the frame and becomes the next horizon; a colour field is pushed over the old scene; the camera pulls back until the painting is a canvas on a wall.
styles.sound: Bristle on canvas, a low cello, a distant buoy bell, wind, gulls; warm analogue room, no digital air.

tr.look: Yağlı boya: kalın, yönlü fırça vuruşları; sırtları ışık tutar, renk yan yana kırılmış, tuval dokusu aralarında görünür.
tr.type: Playfair Display büyük harf, koyu kurşuni; altında küçük aralıklı sans.
tr.motion: Tuval boyanır: vuruş grupları geniş paslarla gelir, indikten sonra hiçbiri kıpırdamaz.
tr.sound: Tuvale fırça, alçak çello, uzak şamandıra çanı, rüzgâr, martı.
tr.avoid: Pürüzsüz gölgeleme, gradyan, düz vektör şekil, saydamlık, kontur.

en.look: Oil impasto: thick directional brush strokes, ridges catching light, colour broken side by side, canvas weave showing through.
en.type: Playfair Display caps in deep slate; a small tracked sans beneath.
en.motion: The canvas is painted: groups of strokes arrive in broad passes and then hold perfectly still.
en.sound: Bristle on canvas, low cello, a distant buoy bell, wind, gulls.
en.avoid: Smooth shading, gradients, flat vector shapes, transparency, outlines.

styles.name: Charcoal drawing
styles.essence: Vine charcoal on rough grey paper: soft black masses smudged with the thumb, a pale window lifted out with an eraser, fur and whiskers scratched back to the paper, the tooth of the sheet breaking every edge.
styles.not: Not graphite pencil (that is fine line hatching on white), not an ink wash, not a photo in greyscale; no colour, no sharp vector edges, no even grey fills, no white paint.
styles.render: Warm grey paper #cfc6b6, charcoal #191512 in three densities (mass, mid #5b544a, dust .2-.4) - no colour, no white paint: every light is ERASED back to the paper. Masses are three or four overlapping ellipse/path shapes in ONE <g> under <filter><feTurbulence baseFrequency='.012' numOctaves='2'/><feDisplacementMap scale='24'/><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation='5'/></filter> so their overlaps melt into a single sooty form. Smudging is a second pass: 10-14 long low-alpha (#5b544a .18-.3) blurred strokes dragged along the form, plus a dust layer of the tooth pattern (a 26 px <pattern> of 1-3 px specks) over every mass at .3. The tooth breaks the edge: clip each mass with a noise mask so its contour is eaten into flecks rather than a line. Lights come back with eraser strokes filled in paper #efe9db at .8-.95 (ragged 3-12 px paths, one group with a 2 px displacement and .8 blur): the window as a big lifted rectangle, a rim of light along the back and skull, whiskers as six hairlines. Highlight edges never close, they stop where the eraser stopped.
styles.composition: A cat sits in profile on a windowsill, nearly black against the erased window light, its tail curled along the ledge; the window is a lifted pale rectangle with a soft mullion cross behind it; smudge drifts out past the frame into the empty grey paper; headline in the upper left over untouched paper.
styles.colour: Paper #cfc6b6, a second warm grey #b8ae9d for the lifted window, charcoal #191512 and its mid #5b544a; no hue at all beyond what the paper already carries.
styles.type: Anton caps 170-200 px in charcoal, blunt and pressed hard, as if the letters were blocked in with the side of the stick; a small Inter Tight 500 caps line at .3 em under it in the mid grey.
styles.motion: Charcoal, not animation: a mass is smudged in over .4-.6 s from a slightly larger, softer state to its final shape; eraser lights are dragged on left to right over .3 s each; whiskers draw on last. No bounce, no float.
styles.camera: Locked on the sheet; a slow 1.05 push toward the cat, or a drift that shows more of the grey paper.
styles.transitions: An eraser wipe clears the frame; a smudge of black spreads and becomes the next night; the sheet is turned over and the next drawing is already there.
styles.sound: Charcoal on rough paper, an eraser rub, a low piano note, a soft breath, a distant street; no music beat.

tr.look: Füzen: yumuşak siyah kütleler parmakla dağıtılmış, pencere silgiyle kâğıda geri açılmış, tüyler ve bıyıklar kazınmış, kâğıdın dokusu her kenarı kırıyor.
tr.type: Anton büyük harf, kömürle bloklanmış gibi; altında küçük aralıklı sans.
tr.motion: Kütleler dağıtılarak gelir, silgi ışıkları soldan sağa çekilir, bıyıklar en son çizilir.
tr.sound: Kâğıtta füzen, silgi, tek piyano notası, uzak sokak.
tr.avoid: Renk, keskin vektör kenar, düz gri dolgu, beyaz boya, foto gri ton.

en.look: Charcoal: soft black masses thumbed out, the window lifted back to paper with an eraser, fur and whiskers scratched in, the sheet's tooth breaking every edge.
en.type: Anton caps, blocked in like charcoal; a small tracked sans beneath.
en.motion: Masses smudge in, eraser lights drag left to right, whiskers drawn last.
en.sound: Charcoal on rough paper, an eraser, one piano note, a distant street.
en.avoid: Colour, sharp vector edges, flat grey fills, white paint, greyscale photos.

styles.name: Graphite sketch
styles.essence: A drawing still in progress: pencil on paper, construction lines and the block-in box left in, hatching that changes pressure line by line, thumb smudges, eraser bites, and an edge where the pencil simply stopped.
styles.not: Not charcoal (no black masses or smudged tonal fields), not a clean vector line drawing, not an ink drawing; no flat fills, no colour, no perfect curves, no finished-looking polish.
styles.render: Only graphite on paper #f5f1e8: #3a3733 at .15-.85 alpha, 0.8-3.4 px, round caps, every path nudged by a 0.4-1.2 px seeded jitter so no two lines are parallel. Form is HATCHING, not fill: each shadow is a family of 12-40 separate short lines at one angle (55-80 deg for verticals, 10-25 deg for the table) whose alpha and width wander line to line - at least 4 values per family - and a second family crossing at 25-40 deg only where the tone is darkest. Layer three passes on the shadow side (base, cross, and a tight 6B #1b1815 pass at pitch 3-4) until it is close to solid near-black, with the paper left as the only highlight. The still life is drawn big: pot, cup and saucer fill about half the frame height. Leave the drawing OPEN: long construction lines run through and past the objects at .12-.2 (horizontals that overshoot both edges, one vertical guide, one diagonal), visible ellipse guides at the rim, base and saucer, a light bounding box around the pot with its corners overshooting, and the hatching stops dead at an invisible boundary rather than following the form to the end. Smudges: 4-6 blurred graphite patches at .12-.28 where a thumb rested, heavier on one side of the sheet; eraser bites: 3-5 paper-colour soft blobs at .5-.8 cutting into the shading, with the hatching resuming thinner on the other side.
styles.composition: A copper cezve and a small coffee cup on its saucer stand on a table line across the lower half, the cezve left of centre with its long handle sweeping up to the right, the cup to its right; the table line, a vertical guide and ellipse construction lines run through and past both objects, the cast shadow is hatched out to the right, the headline sits in the clean upper left and the shading stops before the right edge, leaving the drawing unfinished there.
styles.colour: Paper #f5f1e8 and graphite #3a3733 in five pressures down to #b9b2a6, with a 6B #1b1815 for the deepest shadow side; nothing else - the 'warmth' comes from the paper, not from the pencil.
styles.type: Instrument Serif 400 caps, 130-160 px, letterspaced .02 em, in graphite as if lettered by hand; a small Inter Tight 500 caps line at .3 em under it, lighter than the headline.
styles.motion: Drawn on: hatching groups wipe in left to right behind a clip edge over .4-.7 s each, construction lines draw first and stay, the outline strokes come in 0.2 s after their hatch, eraser beats wipe back over a shadow. Nothing moves after it lands.
styles.camera: Locked on the sheet, as if on a drawing board; a slow 1.06 push on the pot, or a drift to show the unfinished edge.
styles.transitions: A pencil line is drawn and becomes the next horizon; the page is turned; an eraser wipes the old drawing out of the frame.
styles.sound: Pencil on paper, an eraser, paper being turned, a soft graphite scrape, a low room tone with a distant street and a spoon on porcelain.

tr.look: Kurşun kalem eskiz: cezve ve fincan kare boyunun yarısını doldurur, yapım çizgileri ve elipsler kalmış, tarama 6B'ye kadar koyulaşıyor, parmak izi, silgi ısırığı.
tr.type: Instrument Serif büyük harf, elle yazılmış gibi; altında küçük ve daha açık sans.
tr.motion: Çizilir: taramalar soldan sağa silinerek girer, yapım çizgileri önce gelir ve kalır.
tr.sound: Kâğıtta kalem, silgi, sayfa çevirme, uzak sokak, porselende kaşık.
tr.avoid: Füzen kütlesi, düz dolgu, renk, kusursuz eğri, bitmiş cila.

en.look: Graphite sketch: the cezve and cup fill half the frame, construction lines and ellipses left in, hatching darkening to 6B, thumb smudges, eraser bites, the pencil stopping at one edge.
en.type: Instrument Serif caps, hand-lettered; a small, lighter tracked sans beneath.
en.motion: Drawn: hatching wipes in left to right, construction lines arrive first and stay.
en.sound: Pencil on paper, an eraser, a page turned, a distant street, a spoon on porcelain.
en.avoid: Charcoal masses, flat fills, colour, perfect curves, finished polish.

styles.name: Wax crayon
styles.essence: A drawing made with wax crayons by a confident child: fat broken strokes that skip over the tooth of the paper, colour scribbled in until it is almost solid, outlines overshooting their corners, bright primaries laid straight on the sheet.
styles.not: Not coloured pencil (too fine and blended), not pastel/chalk dust, not watercolour, not vector flat colour; no gradients, no soft shading, no clean closed outlines, no muted palette.
styles.render: Six wax colours only (#e03b2f, #ef7c22, #f2c130, #3f9d4e, #2f5fb0, #33302c) on paper #fbf8ef. Every area is SCRIBBLED IN, never filled: 2-3 passes of a zigzag path (a single <path> whose d alternates l/l-l with a 3-9 deg wobble, 40-80 teeth per pass) at a slightly different angle per pass, stroke-width 9-22, .55-.9 alpha, so the strokes cross and leave paper between them. The wax skips: put each group under one <mask> whose fill is a 19x21 px <pattern> of small black specks covering 5-12 % - the tooth of the sheet - so strokes thin out and break in flecks instead of ending clean; the stroke DIRECTION has to stay readable, so keep the specks small and the passes 25-30 px apart rather than filling solid. Outlines are laid over the fill 2-4 px out of register, darker and heavier, overshooting the corner by 10-30 px. Press harder where the child pressed: a second pass in the same colour at .9 inside the middle of the shape. Where two colours overlap (blue over yellow) let the lower one show through the holes.
styles.composition: A sparrow sits on a branch that runs across the lower third, drawn big and round with one enormous eye; a scribbled sun with straight rays in the upper right; a band of green grass scribbled along the bottom edge, pale blue sky scribbled only in patches; the headline lettered big in the clean upper left.
styles.colour: Red #e03b2f, orange #ef7c22, yellow #f2c130, green #3f9d4e, blue #2f5fb0 and black #33302c, all at full brightness on cream paper; at most three colours per subject, no tints or shades.
styles.type: Shrikhand or Anton caps, 150-190 px, in a single wax colour with wobbly edges, as if spelled out by a careful child; a small Inter Tight 500 caps line under it.
styles.motion: Crayon on paper: each scribble pass wipes on in .25-.4 s in the direction it was drawn, the outline comes after the fill, the colour overshoots by 8 px and settles; a colour is pressed in twice on the beat. No float, no fade-ins, no scaling.
styles.camera: Locked on the sheet, as if the drawing were lying on a table; at most a 1.05 push toward the bird or a small drift.
styles.transitions: A fat crayon line is dragged across and becomes the next horizon; a colour scribbles the old frame out; the page is turned.
styles.sound: Wax on paper, a wooden chair, a child humming, a bird outside, a xylophone; warm room, no polish.

tr.look: Mum boya: kâğıdın dokusunda atlayan kalın kırık çizgiler, neredeyse doluya kadar karalanmış parlak ana renkler, köşeleri taşan konturlar.
tr.type: Shrikhand büyük harf, tek renk, çocuk eliyle yazılmış gibi.
tr.motion: Karalama pasları çizildikleri yönde girer, kontur dolgudan sonra gelir, renk 8 px taşıp oturur.
tr.sound: Kâğıtta mum boya, tahta sandalye, çocuk mırıltısı, dışarıda kuş, ksilofon.
tr.avoid: Gradyan, yumuşak gölge, düz vektör renk, ince uçlu kalem, soluk palet.

en.look: Wax crayon: fat broken strokes skipping over the paper's tooth, bright primaries scribbled nearly solid, outlines overshooting their corners.
en.type: Shrikhand caps, one wax colour, as if spelled out by a careful child.
en.motion: Scribble passes wipe on in the direction they were drawn, outline after fill, colour overshoots 8 px and settles.
en.sound: Wax on paper, a wooden chair, a child humming, a bird outside, a xylophone.
en.avoid: Gradients, soft shading, flat vector colour, fine pencil, muted palette.

styles.name: Scratchboard
styles.essence: White lines scratched out of a black-inked board: there is no paint at all, only the burin's bright cut, and every tone of the picture is the distance between two scratches - dense where the light falls, bare black in the shadow.
styles.not: Not white ink drawn on black paper, not a photo negative, not a linocut (which prints black on light paper); no grey fills, no blur, no soft shading, no second colour.
styles.render: A #0d0c0b ground and NOTHING but #f6f2e8 scratches 1.4-3.2 px wide, round caps, .75-1 alpha: tone is pitch, never a fill - light areas have scratches every 4-5 px, mid every 8-11, shadow has none at all and stays black. Build each area as one <path> of many subpaths under a <clipPath>: feathers as nested elliptical ARCS (M..A..) at radii stepping 5-7 px with 20-30 % of each ring missing, so the form turns; the wing and branch as two straight families crossing at 40-60 deg; the belly as arcs crowded to 3.5 px. Every scratch is jittered 0.6-1.4 px and its ends never quite meet, so nothing reads as a printed screen. The moon is scratched nearly solid (pitch 2.4, two crossing families) with its limb left black; the pupil and the gap under the bird stay pure black. A dozen stray scratches wander off the drawing into the black where the burin slipped.
styles.composition: An owl sits front-on in the middle, its eye discs the brightest thing in the frame, feathers turning with the body, talons closing on a branch that crosses the lower third; a scratched moon high right; the headline in the upper left in scratch-white, and black air around the bird so it reads as one bright shape.
styles.colour: Board black #0d0c0b, scratch white #f6f2e8, and the bone #cfc6b4 of scratches made with a duller point; no hue anywhere, no grey - only line density.
styles.type: Anton caps 170-200 px, scratch-white, with the edges broken like a cut; a small Inter Tight 500 caps line at .32 em underneath in the bone tone.
styles.motion: Scratched in: the burin runs - a clip edge sweeps each group in the direction the lines were cut (.3-.5 s), densest areas last; the eyes are cut open with two quick circles. Nothing moves after it is cut.
styles.camera: Locked on the board; at most a 1.05 push toward the eyes, or a drift that reveals more black at the edge.
styles.transitions: A scratch line sweeps and becomes the next horizon; the frame is scratched away to black; the board is wiped with ink and the next drawing is cut into it.
styles.sound: A steel point scratching clay, a dry board tap, an owl far off, a low bowed string with no reverb; near silence between cuts.

tr.look: Kazıma: siyah zeminden beyaz çizgiler kazınmış; hiç dolgu yok, ton yalnızca çizgi sıklığı; tüyler gövdeye göre dönen yaylar.
tr.type: Anton büyük harf, kazınmış gibi kırık kenarlı; altında küçük aralıklı sans.
tr.motion: Kazınır: keski çizgileri sırayla açar, en yoğun yerler en son; sonra hiçbir şey kıpırdamaz.
tr.sound: Kile kazınan çelik uç, tahta tıkırtısı, uzak baykuş, alçak yaylı.
tr.avoid: Beyaz boya, gri dolgu, bulanıklık, ikinci renk, negatif fotoğraf.

en.look: Scratchboard: white lines cut out of black, no fill anywhere, tone only from line pitch, feathers as arcs turning with the body.
en.type: Anton caps, broken edges like a cut; a small tracked sans beneath.
en.motion: Scratched in: the burin opens groups in order, densest last, then nothing moves.
en.sound: Steel on clay board, a dry tap, an owl far off, a low bowed string.
en.avoid: White paint, grey fills, blur, a second colour, photo negatives.

styles.name: Mid-century illustration
styles.essence: A 1950s-60s advertising illustration: flat poster colour printed a few millimetres out of register, every form held by a confident black keyline, atomic starbursts, boomerangs and tapered steam curls, a household object treated like a monument.
styles.not: Not a photo, not a clean vector logo, not grain-free digital flatness, not pastel, not retro-sixties psychedelia; no gradients inside a shape, no soft shadow, no rounded friendly blob without a keyline, no halftone dots (that is riso).
styles.render: Four inks on cream: #f3e7cd paper, mustard #e3a72f, teal #2f7d78, coral #d95f3b, charcoal #241f1b. Every shape is drawn TWICE: first a flat ghost of the same path filled with the neighbouring ink, translated 16-24 px on x and 12-18 px on y and never stroked; then the real shape, filled flat and stroked with charcoal at 7-9 px (linejoin round, no dashes). That ghost peeking out along one edge is the whole medium - it must happen on the big blocks, on the subject and on the type. Form is closed and simple: one silhouette, no internal gradient, shadow described by a second flat shape or a keyline that thickens on the shaded side. Nuclear-age ornament, always in the margin: an atomic starburst of 12-16 tapered solid triangles radiating from a dot with small circles at the tips, and boomerangs (a crescent made of two arcs, one pointed end) floating at 15-40 deg. Steam, smoke and motion are single curling ribbons with a round cap. Keep all keylines the same weight in one picture; the eye should feel a screen print of an ad, not a cartoon.
styles.composition: Poster stack: headline in the top left, a starburst balancing it at the top right, a big flat colour block behind the subject, the subject centred in the lower middle third on a saucer or a ground line, boomerangs in the empty corners, one small tracked caption near the bottom; generous cream margins, nothing touching the frame.
styles.colour: Cream #f3e7cd, mustard #e3a72f, teal #2f7d78, coral #d95f3b, charcoal #241f1b - and a lighter glass white #fbf3e2 for transparencies. Each area is ONE flat ink; a colour is never a tint or a gradient. Coral and mustard carry the warmth, teal is the cool counterweight, charcoal only for keylines, type and one solid band.
styles.type: Poppins 700 or Montserrat 700, caps, 100-130 px, tracking 0.01-0.03 em, charcoal, sometimes with a 10 px coral or mustard offset copy behind it (the type is printed out of register too); a small line in Inter Tight 500 caps tracked 0.3 em beneath.
styles.motion: Mechanical and cheerful: each piece slides in 40-70 px on its own diagonal in 0.3 s with power3.out and a 2 % overshoot, then holds dead still; the starburst pops from its centre once; nothing loops, nothing breathes, no slow drift.
styles.camera: Locked and frontal like a printed page; at most a 1.04 push toward the subject, or a 4 px lateral drift as if the sheet were fed through a press.
styles.transitions: A flat colour block wipes across and becomes the next ground; the starburst blooms open to reveal the next frame; a keyline draws itself around the frame edge and closes on the cut.
styles.sound: Warm mid-century lounge: vibraphone, upright bass, brushed snare, a small brass stab on the starburst, a teaspoon on porcelain, a soft paper slide.

tr.look: 50'ler reklam illüstrasyonu: krem kâğıt üzerine düz baskı renkleri birkaç milim kaymış, her form kalın siyah konturlu; atom yıldızı, bumerang, kıvrık buhar, sıradan bir ev eşyası anıt gibi.
tr.type: Poppins 700 büyük harf, altında ince aralıklı küçük satır; yazının da arkasında kaymış renk kopyası.
tr.motion: Mekanik ve neşeli: parçalar kendi köşegeninde kayar, bir kez taşar ve durur; yıldız bir kez açılır.
tr.sound: Vibrafon, kontrbas, fırçalı davul, kısa brass vuruşu, porselen kaşık.
tr.avoid: Gradyan, yumuşak gölge, pastel, kontursuz yuvarlak leke, tram noktaları.

en.look: 1950s ad illustration: flat inks on cream printed a few millimetres out of register, every form held by a black keyline; atomic starburst, boomerangs, curling steam, an everyday object as a monument.
en.type: Poppins 700 caps over a thin tracked line; the type carries its own offset colour ghost.
en.motion: Mechanical and cheerful: parts slide on their own diagonal, overshoot once, hold; the burst opens once.
en.sound: Vibraphone, upright bass, brushed snare, a short brass stab, a porcelain spoon.
en.avoid: Gradients, soft shadows, pastels, unlined round blobs, halftone dots.

styles.name: Comic pop panel
styles.essence: One 1960s comic-book panel blown up to the frame: Ben-Day dots in every flat field, a thick black contour around everything, four primaries, and a speech balloon with hand-lettered caps - a street-corner scene, not a copy of a famous panel.
styles.not: Not clean vector cartoon, not anime, not a halftone photo, not soft shading, not pastel; no gradient, no thin outline, no realistic anatomy, no brand characters, no copy of an existing comic panel.
styles.render: Four inks only: paper #f7f2e4, black #141414, red #d5281f, yellow #f5c518, blue #1d63b8 (plus one ochre #e0a33f for the simit). Ground fields are FLAT colour with Ben-Day dots: an SVG <pattern> of r 7 circles on a 26 px cell, rotated 15-20 deg, dot and ground in two different inks (red dots on yellow, white dots on blue); a second dot pattern on transparent is clipped over the shadow side of the face and the shirt. Every contour is one black stroke at 9-14 px, linejoin round, closed; no interior line under 6 px. Shading is a second flat shape or dot field, never a gradient - a shadow is a hard-edged shape in the darker ink laid over the dots. The speech balloon is a rounded polygon in paper white with a 10 px black contour and a triangular tail pointed at the mouth; its lettering is heavy caps inside the balloon.
styles.composition: A framed panel with a 16 px black border and a cream page margin: balloon in the upper third, a head-and-shoulders figure in the centre looking at us and shouting, a tray of simits held at the bottom right, flat dot fields behind. Diagonal energy lines in the empty corners, nothing overlapping the balloon.
styles.colour: Red #d5281f, yellow #f5c518, blue #1d63b8, black #141414 on paper #f7f2e4, plus ochre #e0a33f for the pastry. Colours are flat and pure; each field is a solid + its own dot screen, and the black is reserved for contour, hair and lettering.
styles.type: Poppins 700 caps inside the balloon at 90-110 px, tight leading, letterspaced -0.01 em, black on white; a small sticker line in Montserrat 700 caps. No lowercase lettering in the panel.
styles.motion: Comic timing: the panel border snaps in, the balloon pops from 0.8 with one 6 % overshoot, the figure rises 90 px and stops, a dot field can flash one step darker for two frames on the shout. Nothing smooth, nothing slow, no cross-fades.
styles.camera: Dead frontal, flat as printed paper; the only move is a 1.05 push into the face or a 3 px shake on the shout.
styles.transitions: A colour field slams across the frame; the balloon's outline draws itself around the cut; a hard cut on the shout with one frame of inverted dots.
styles.sound: Bright and punchy: a snare crack, a tuba blat, a vibraphone run, crowd murmur on the quay, a paper rustle, one shouted syllable.

tr.look: Tek çizgi roman karesi: her düz alanda Ben-Day noktaları, her şeyin çevresinde kalın siyah kontur, dört ana renk, konuşma balonu.
tr.type: Balonun içinde kalın büyük harfler; küçük etikette sıkı aralıklı satır.
tr.motion: Komik zamanlama: çerçeve çat diye girer, balon bir kez taşarak açılır, figür yükselip durur.
tr.sound: Trampet şaklaması, tuba, vibrafon, iskele uğultusu, kâğıt hışırtısı.
tr.avoid: Gradyan, ince çizgi, yumuşak gölge, pastel, gerçekçi anatomi, ünlü bir kareyi kopyalamak.

en.look: One comic panel: Ben-Day dots in every flat field, thick black contour on everything, four primaries, a speech balloon.
en.type: Heavy caps inside the balloon; a tight tracked sticker line.
en.motion: Comic timing: the frame snaps in, the balloon pops with one overshoot, the figure rises and stops.
en.sound: Snare crack, tuba blat, vibraphone run, quay murmur, paper rustle.
en.avoid: Gradients, thin lines, soft shading, pastels, realistic anatomy, copying a famous panel.

styles.name: Bauhaus study
styles.essence: A Bauhaus poster-study: the whole picture built from a circle, a square and a triangle in the three primaries on off-white, everything on a strict orthogonal grid, a lowercase sans headline, no ornament at all - an object analysed into its primitive solids.
styles.not: Not a retro pastiche, not 1970s graphic design, not decoration, not hand-drawn, not textured, not asymmetric for its own sake; no gradients, no keylines around forms (except the one black construction line), no more than three colours plus black, no script or serif type.
styles.render: One off-white ground #f2efe4; every form is ONE flat primitive: a circle (fill #d8352a), a square (#1f4fa8) and a triangle (#f2c11c), plus black #141414 as line, dot and type. No outlines - forms touch each other by overlap and colour change, which is how the object is described. The composition sits on a single black horizontal construction line (8-10 px) and one vertical rule; the object's parts are laid on those two axes, so the picture looks measured. Type is lowercase, sans, black, one word, set flush to the left margin with wide air around it; a small lowercase line at 0.25 em tracking. Primitives are pure: a true 60 degree triangle, a circle, a square with square corners - never rounded, never skewed, never duplicated as decoration. Empty off-white is a material: keep at least a third of the frame bare.
styles.composition: Asymmetrical balance on a grid: a huge lowercase word in the upper left, the constructed object centred on the lower two thirds, a small triad of the three primitives as a footnote in the bottom corner, one black line through everything; all margins different, nothing centred.
styles.colour: Off-white #f2efe4, red #d8352a, blue #1f4fa8, yellow #f2c11c, black #141414. Exactly three chromatic inks, each used once or twice, in large flat areas; black is only type, the construction line and small solids. No tints, no shades, no fourth hue.
styles.type: Poppins 500 lowercase, 240-300 px, tight tracking -0.03 em, black; one small lowercase line in Poppins 500 with 0.24 em tracking. No caps, no italic, no underline.
styles.motion: Constructed in front of us: the circle grows from 0.86 to 1 in 0.3 s, the square drops 40 px and lands, the triangle turns 8 deg into place, the black line draws from left to right; power2.out only, everything stops dead, long hold after 2 s.
styles.camera: Locked, orthogonal, like a photograph of a print; no push, no parallax - at most a 3 px re-centre.
styles.transitions: A square grows from the centre and fills the frame; the black construction line sweeps across and the next scene is drawn on it; a hard cut on the beat.
styles.sound: Dry and precise: a woodblock, a single piano note with the pedal down, a soft mallet on metal, paper sliding on a table; no melody.

tr.look: Bauhaus etüdü: daire, kare, üçgen; kırmızı-sarı-mavi, kırık beyaz zemin, katı bir ızgara, siyah inşa çizgisi, süs yok.
tr.type: Poppins küçük harf, çok büyük tek kelime; altında geniş aralıklı küçük satır.
tr.motion: Önümüzde kurulur: daire büyür, kare düşer, üçgen yerine döner, çizgi soldan çekilir; hepsi birden durur.
tr.sound: Ahşap blok, tek piyano notası, yumuşak tokmak, kâğıt.
tr.avoid: Gradyan, gölge, süs, kontur, dördüncü renk, el çizimi, eğri köşe.

en.look: Bauhaus study: circle, square, triangle; red-yellow-blue on off-white, a strict grid, one black construction line, no ornament.
en.type: Poppins lowercase, one very large word; a wide-tracked small line under it.
en.motion: Built in front of us: the circle grows, the square lands, the triangle turns into place, the line draws; all stop dead.
en.sound: Woodblock, one piano note, a soft mallet, paper.
en.avoid: Gradients, shadows, ornament, outlines, a fourth colour, hand drawing, rounded corners.

styles.name: Synthwave retro-future
styles.essence: An 1980s retro-future night: a striped neon sun setting behind hard mountain silhouettes, an infinite magenta grid floor to the vanishing point, chrome display type burning over it, and a boxy coupe driving away into the glow.
styles.not: Not cyberpunk city clutter, not anime, not 1990s clip art, not pastel vapourwave; no daylight, no photorealism, no flat vector without glow, no rounded friendly shapes, no real brand logos.
styles.render: A vertical <linearGradient> sky #12002b -> #3b0b52 -> #8a1a6a with the horizon at 61 % of the height; the sun is one circle with a <linearGradient> #ffe66d -> #ff9f43 -> #ff2d95, masked by a <mask> of black horizontal bars whose thickness grows toward the bottom, so the lower half is sliced into stripes. Mountains are hard polygons #130726 with a 4 px #26e0ff rim on the ridge only. The floor is a plane in perspective: 19 <line>s from the vanishing point (540, 1180) to the bottom edge, crossed by 12 horizontals at y = 1180 + 740 * (k/12)^2.4, all #ff2d95 at .5-.7 alpha, each drawn twice - a 7 px blurred copy for bloom plus a 2.5 px crisp line. Chrome type = a CSS linear-gradient (white -> #9fe8ff -> #2b8cff -> #7a2bff -> #ff5ec4 -> white) with background-clip:text, plus two drop-shadows (pink 18 px, cyan 46 px). The car is a single dark polygon with cyan rim light on its left edge, magenta on its right, a tail-light bar drawn three times (blurred #ff2d5e, crisp #ff2d5e, hot #ffd0e0 core) and a chrome bumper strip.
styles.composition: Symmetrical stage: sun dead centre over the horizon, chrome word across the top third, the car low and centred with the grid vanishing exactly under it, mountain silhouettes left and right framing the glow; empty sky between the type and the sun.
styles.colour: Night #12002b, deep purple #3b0b52, hot magenta #ff2d95, cyan #26e0ff, sun yellow #ffe66d, hot red #ff2d5e, chrome white #f2fbff. Saturated neon on near-black only; each glow is the same hue as the line it belongs to.
styles.type: Poppins 700 caps, 150-175 px, tracking 0.04-0.08 em, chromed with the gradient and glowing; one small line in Inter Tight 500 caps tracked 0.4 em in cyan below it. Type is always centred on the axis.
styles.motion: Slow synth pads, fast machines: the sun rises 40 px and holds, grid lines fade up from the horizon outward, the car glides in from the bottom with power2.out and settles, the chrome type flickers once like a neon tube striking. Nothing rotates, nothing bounces.
styles.camera: Locked on the axis; one slow 1.05 push toward the sun, or a low tilt that ends on the chrome word.
styles.transitions: The grid accelerates and swallows the frame; a horizontal scanline wipe; the sun's stripes close into a solid disc and cut to the next scene.
styles.sound: Gated reverb drums, a saw bass arpeggio, glassy pads, a car door thud, a neon buzz on the type reveal.

tr.look: 80'ler retro-fütür gece: şeritli neon güneş, sert dağ siluetleri, ufka giden macenta ızgara zemin, krom yazı, arkadan uzaklaşan kutu gibi bir coupe.
tr.type: Krom kaplı kalın büyük harfler, eksene ortalanmış; altında ince aralıklı camgöbeği satır.
tr.motion: Yavaş pedallar, hızlı makineler: güneş yükselip durur, ızgara ufuktan dışa açar, araba aşağıdan süzülüp oturur, yazı bir kez flaş gibi titrer.
tr.sound: Gate'li davul, testere bas arpej, cam gibi pedler, araba kapısı, neon uğultusu.
tr.avoid: Gündüz, fotogerçekçilik, pastel vapourwave, şehir kalabalığı, gerçek marka logosu.

en.look: 80s retro-future night: striped neon sun, hard mountain silhouettes, a magenta grid floor to the horizon, chrome type, a boxy coupe driving away.
en.type: Chrome heavy caps centred on the axis; a thin tracked cyan line beneath.
en.motion: Slow pads, fast machines: the sun rises and holds, the grid opens from the horizon, the car glides in and settles, the type flickers once.
en.sound: Gated drums, saw bass arpeggio, glassy pads, a car door, neon buzz.
en.avoid: Daylight, photorealism, pastel vapourwave, city clutter, real brand logos.

styles.name: Silkscreen travel poster
styles.essence: A 1950s travel poster pulled in 5 flat screen inks: a huge landscape reduced to three or four silhouettes, a destination set in a bold condensed sans, no gradients anywhere, the paper doing the light.
styles.not: Not a photoreal landscape, not an illustration with shading, not riso dots, not a gradient sky, not an outlined drawing; no more than 5 inks, no thin detail under 8 px, no copy of an existing tourist poster.
styles.render: Exactly 5 inks on paper #f2e6cd: ochre #e0a23e, terracotta #c2553a, dusty rose #d98f7a, deep teal #1c4f55. Each ink is ONE flat shape layer, back to front, edge to edge with no outline and no gradient; depth comes from stacking the inks, never from a tint - a shape is either an ink or paper. The Cappadocia valley is built from 2-3 overlapping planes, one ink each: a distant rose ridge with small cones, a mid ochre plane of fairy chimneys, and a near terracotta plane of large capped cones that overlap each other and run down to y ~1740. Every chimney is a silhouette with a tapered base, a narrow waist and a wide rounded cap; group many chimneys into a single <path> of subpaths per plane. Where two inks meet, let them overlap 2-4 px and multiply (a screen print overprints); a 2-3 px misregistration on ONE layer per poster is allowed. Balloons are large enough to carry the sky: a body of gores (paper, teal, ochre rectangles clipped to the balloon profile), ropes and a basket. Type is a solid block of one ink, knocked out or printed over the lightest band, never outlined. Keep the horizon high and leave the upper sky as bare paper so the type can breathe.
styles.composition: Poster hierarchy: destination name in the top left, a line of small tracked type under it, three balloons at different depths in the sky (the largest right of centre), then the Cappadocia valley receding in three overlapping planes - a distant rose ridge, a mid ochre row of fairy chimneys, and a near terracotta band of big capped cones that fill the frame down to y ~1740, the paper left as sky and as a narrow margin along the bottom.
styles.colour: Paper #f2e6cd, ochre #e0a23e, terracotta #c2553a, dusty rose #d98f7a, deep teal #1c4f55. Five inks, each a large flat area; the teal is the darkest and carries the type, the rose is atmosphere, the ochre is the light.
styles.type: Anton caps at 120-140 px, tracking 0.01 em, deep teal, set flush left; a line of Inter Tight 500 caps tracked 0.32 em underneath in terracotta. Type is printed flat, no shadow, no outline, no curve.
styles.motion: Screen-print flats: each ink layer slides up 30-50 px into register in 0.3 s and stops; the balloons drift less than 10 px; the type stamps in last, whole, one frame of overshoot. Long hold.
styles.camera: Locked, poster-flat; a 1.05 push toward the balloons or a 5 px vertical drift as the sheet is fed.
styles.transitions: An ink band wipes up the frame; the horizon line rises and becomes the next sky; a hard cut with one frame of the previous ink.
styles.sound: Open air and light: a warm string swell, an accordion or clarinet phrase, wind, a distant balloon burner, paper.

tr.look: Serigrafi seyahat afişi: beş düz mürekkep, kâğıt ışığı taşır, manzara üç dört siluete indirgenmiş, kontur ve gradyan yok.
tr.type: Anton büyük harf, sola yaslı; altında geniş aralıklı ince satır.
tr.motion: Düz mürekkepler: her katman 30-50 px kayıp yerine oturur ve durur; balonlar ancak 10 px süzülür.
tr.sound: Yaylılar, klarnet, rüzgâr, uzakta balon brülörü, kâğıt.
tr.avoid: Gradyan, fotogerçekçilik, tram noktaları, kontur, ince detay, var olan bir afişi kopyalamak.

en.look: Silkscreen travel poster: five flat inks, paper carries the light, the landscape reduced to three or four silhouettes, no outline and no gradient.
en.type: Anton caps flush left; a wide-tracked thin line beneath.
en.motion: Flat inks: each layer slides 30-50 px into register and stops; balloons drift under 10 px.
en.sound: Strings, clarinet, wind, a distant burner, paper.
en.avoid: Gradients, photorealism, halftone dots, outlines, fine detail, copying an existing poster.

styles.name: Botanical plate
styles.essence: An 18th-19th century hand-coloured engraving: one specimen drawn in fine burin lines and cross-hatching on aged paper, tinted with thin watercolour washes, its parts dissected and numbered at the side, and a thin Latin caption under a ruled plate mark.
styles.not: Not a modern infographic, not a photo, not a flat vector flower, not a children's illustration; no thick outlines, no saturated colour, no drop shadows, no sans-serif caption, no clip-art leaves.
styles.render: Aged paper #e9dcc0 with 6-8 foxing blotches (#b5905a at .1, blurred) and a plate mark: a 2 px double rule 8 px apart around the drawing, and the sheet left bare outside it. All drawing is ONE sepia ink #4a3623: outlines at 2.4-3.4 px, never filled - shadow is a field of parallel burin lines (an SVG <pattern> of 1.6 px lines on 8 px, rotated 38 deg) or a cross-hatch at 38/-38 deg for the darkest passages, plus stipple dots for soft transitions. Hand tint sits UNDER the lines: flat muted washes (sage #7f9161, rose #b5695d, ochre #c79a4e, blue-grey #93a7a3) at .3-.45 opacity, their edges blurred 5-8 px so they look floated on, never a hard vector fill and never covering a contour. The plate carries a specimen (flower, stem, leaves, bulb and roots) plus 4-5 dissected details stacked in a side column, each with a small engraved number; a hairline leader only where the part is far away.
styles.composition: Portrait plate: specimen filling the left two thirds, dissected details in a narrow column at the right, the Latin caption on the baseline inside the plate mark, a wider bare margin at the bottom; nothing is centred, the stem is the vertical the eye follows.
styles.colour: Aged paper #e9dcc0, sepia ink #4a3623, sage #7f9161, rose #b5695d, ochre #c79a4e, blue-grey #93a7a3. The tints are washes at a third strength, always inside the lines, never a flat poster colour; no pure black, no white.
styles.type: Cormorant Garamond for the plate name (caps, 110-130 px, tracked 0.08 em, sepia) and for the Latin caption (italic, 26-30 px, with the author abbreviation and Tab. number); a tracked small-caps serif line for the vernacular name. No sans-serif anywhere.
styles.motion: Drawn like a plate being inked: the specimen's contour draws in 0.5-0.7 s, the hatched shadow fades in 0.2 s later, the washes bloom in last under the lines; the numbers appear one at a time with the details. Everything settles by 2.2 s and holds.
styles.camera: Locked flat on the page, slight top-light; a 1.06 push toward the flower head, or a slow vertical pan down the stem to the bulb.
styles.transitions: A hairline draws across and becomes the plate's rule; the paper tone washes over the frame; a hard page turn.
styles.sound: Quiet study: a nib on paper, a page turn, a small harpsichord or lute phrase, a glass of water, birds far outside.

tr.look: 18.-19. yüzyıl el boyaması gravür: yaşlı kâğıtta ince burin çizgileri ve tarama, üstüne sulu boya yıkama, yanda numaralı kesitler, altında ince Latince künye.
tr.type: Cormorant Garamond büyük harf başlık; italik Latince künye, aralıklı küçük serif satır.
tr.motion: Levha mürekkeplenir gibi: kontur çizilir, tarama sonra belirir, yıkamalar en son altta açar; numaralar tek tek gelir.
tr.sound: Kâğıtta kalem, sayfa çevirme, lavta, uzakta kuşlar.
tr.avoid: Kalın kontur, doygun renk, gölge, sans-serif, fotoğraf, düz vektör çiçek.

en.look: 18th-19th c. hand-coloured engraving: fine burin lines and hatching on aged paper, thin watercolour washes over them, numbered dissections at the side, a Latin caption below.
en.type: Cormorant Garamond caps for the name; italic Latin caption, tracked small serif line.
en.motion: Inked like a plate: the contour draws, the hatching fades in after, the washes bloom last under the lines; numbers arrive one by one.
en.sound: Nib on paper, a page turn, lute, birds outside.
en.avoid: Thick outlines, saturated colour, shadows, sans-serif, photography, flat vector flowers.

styles.name: Technical cutaway
styles.essence: A drafted cutaway plate: one object sliced open so its insides read as clearly as its outside, every part traced in two or three line weights, cut faces hatched, leader lines with numbered labels at the side, a scale note underneath.
styles.not: Not a blueprint (no cyan, no white-on-blue), not an isometric illustration, not a patent drawing with clutter, not a photo with arrows; no gradients, no shading except hatch, no dotted texture, no more than one accent colour.
styles.render: Black ink #1f1f1f on drafting white #f5f3ec, with ONE accent #d9762b and a pale water blue #cfe3ec. Three line weights only: silhouettes 3.5-4 px, part outlines 2 px, leaders and centrelines 1.2 px (the centreline dash-dot: 26 8 4 8). The cut is a window: the object is drawn closed, then a rectangular opening on one side is cut with an even-odd <path> whose 14 px band is filled with a 45 deg hatch <pattern> (1.4 px lines, 6 px apart) - that hatched band is what makes it read as a section. Inside the window the contents are flat pale fills with their own outlines (water #cfe3ec, heat/tea #e8c9a6, firebox #d9762b at .5). Labels are numbered circles (r 15) at the end of a 1.2 px leader that touches the part with a 4 px dot; the text is Inter Tight 500 lowercase at 28 px, 6 px from the circle. Nothing else on the sheet: no border, no grid, no colour blocks.
styles.composition: Sheet layout: the object centred left on its vertical centreline, the cutaway window on its right half, the numbered labels stacked at the right in the order of the parts, one label on the left for the part that faces that way, headline above in the top left and a scale note on the baseline.
