styles.colour: Drafting white #f5f3ec, ink #1f1f1f, pale water blue #cfe3ec, warm section #e8c9a6, one accent #d9762b (used only for heat, the firebox and the tap); no second accent, no tints of the ink.
styles.type: Montserrat 700 caps at 90-110 px for the object name, tracked 0.04 em; Inter Tight 500 lowercase for the numbered parts at 28 px, and Inter Tight 500 caps tracked 0.3 em for the scale note. All type in ink, never in the accent.
styles.motion: Drafted: the silhouette draws first, the cut window opens (a wipe from the cut edge), the contents fade in, then each leader draws out and its number lands with a tick. 0.3 s each, power2.out, everything settled by 2.2 s.
styles.camera: Locked orthographic; a slow 1.06 push into the cut window, or a vertical tilt from the object name to the base.
styles.transitions: A leader line draws across the cut and becomes the next scene's centreline; a hatched band wipes the frame; hard cut on the beat.
styles.sound: Drafting room: a pencil on paper, a ruler tap, a metal tick on each number, a low room tone, a kettle whistle at the end.

tr.look: Teknik kesit levhası: nesne ortadan kesilip içi gösterilir, kesit yüzeyi taranmış, üç çizgi kalınlığı, numaralı kılavuz çizgileri, altta ölçek notu.
tr.type: Montserrat büyük harf başlık; Inter Tight küçük harf parça adları, aralıklı ölçek notu.
tr.motion: Çizilir: siluet, kesit penceresi, iç parçalar, sonra her kılavuz ve numarası sırayla gelir.
tr.sound: Kâğıtta kurşun kalem, cetvel tıkırtısı, her numarada metal tık, çaydanlık ıslığı.
tr.avoid: Mavi kopya, izometrik, fotoğraf, gradyan, tarama dışı gölge, ikinci vurgu rengi.

en.look: Technical cutaway plate: the object is sectioned to show its inside, cut faces hatched, three line weights, numbered leaders, a scale note below.
en.type: Montserrat caps for the name; Inter Tight lowercase parts, tracked scale note.
en.motion: Drafted: silhouette, cut window, contents, then each leader and its number in order.
en.sound: Pencil on paper, ruler tap, a metal tick per number, a kettle whistle.
en.avoid: Blueprints, isometrics, photos, gradients, shading other than hatch, a second accent.

styles.name: Isotype pictogram chart
styles.essence: An Isotype / Otl Aicher pictogram chart: one standardised symbol - a tea glass - repeated on a strict grid, one symbol standing for ten million, the quantity read by counting rows, a single accent symbol for the remainder, no illustration anywhere.
styles.not: Not an infographic with bars and axes, not emoji, not outline icons, not a dashboard, not decorative icon soup; no gradients, no shadows, no more than two colours plus grey, no tilted or perspective symbols, no numbers written on every icon.
styles.render: One off-white sheet #f7f5ef, one ink #17324d, one accent #e4572e, one grey #b9b7ae. The symbol is a single closed silhouette (a tulip tea glass with a saucer bar) drawn once on a 60x84 unit grid and repeated by transform - never redrawn by eye, so all copies are identical. Repeat on a mathematical grid: cell 150x130, five across, five down, symbols centred in their cells, with a 6 px tick at each row and column start (ink at .3 alpha) instead of a frame. Quantity = count: 24 solid symbols and one whose lower half is accent and upper half grey (the .5), so the total is read without a single axis. The text is a two-line statement at the top and a legend line with one symbol at 36 px, nothing else; numerals in Montserrat 700, labels in Inter Tight 500 with wide tracking. Everything is flat and axis-aligned; white space carries the chart.
styles.composition: Top left: the statement, set large, three lines. Below it a 5x5 field of identical symbols with the half symbol last, then a legend line with one symbol, then a small source note. All flush left to the same margin at x 96; the right edge is left open.
styles.colour: Paper #f7f5ef, navy #17324d for every full symbol and the type, orange #e4572e only for the half symbol and nothing else, grey #b9b7ae for the empty half and the small note. Two colours plus one grey; no tint of the navy.
styles.type: Montserrat 700 for the headline numbers (130-140 px) and Inter Tight 500 caps for the words, tracked 0.06-0.3 em; the legend at 26-30 px, the source note at 24-26 px in grey. Lowercase is never used for the legend; the headline is caps with correct Turkish dotted/dotless i.
styles.motion: Counting: the symbols land one after another, row by row, 40-60 ms apart, each with a 4 % overshoot; the half symbol lands last and its orange half fills. The headline is already there. Everything stops by 2 s, no loop.
styles.camera: Locked flat on the sheet; at most a 1.04 push toward the grid, or a fast cut between two counts.
styles.transitions: A row of symbols slides in and becomes the next row; the grid wipes upward; hard cut on the beat.
styles.sound: Precise and light: a woodblock tick per symbol (panned left to right), a muted marimba, a room tone, a single low note under the half symbol.

tr.look: Isotype piktogram: tek bir standart sembol ızgarada tekrarlanır, bir sembol on milyonu temsil eder, miktar satır sayılarak okunur, kalan için tek vurgu sembolü.
tr.type: Montserrat kalın rakamlar, Inter Tight geniş aralıklı büyük harf; açıklama satırı 26-30 px.
tr.motion: Sayma: semboller satır satır, 40-60 ms arayla, hafif taşarak iner; yarım sembol en son gelir.
tr.sound: Her sembolde ahşap tık (soldan sağa), marimba, tek bas notası.
tr.avoid: Grafik eksenleri, emoji, kontur ikon, gradyan, gölge, her ikona sayı yazmak.

en.look: Isotype pictogram: one standard symbol repeated on a grid, one symbol = ten million, quantity read by counting rows, one accent symbol for the remainder.
en.type: Montserrat bold numerals, wide-tracked Inter Tight caps; a legend line at 26-30 px.
en.motion: Counting: symbols land row by row, 40-60 ms apart, a small overshoot; the half symbol arrives last.
en.sound: A wooden tick per symbol (left to right), marimba, one low note.
en.avoid: Chart axes, emoji, outline icons, gradients, shadows, a number on every icon.

styles.name: Felt appliqué
styles.essence: Shapes cut from wool felt and sewn onto a felt ground: thick matte pieces with soft fuzzy fibre edges, blanket stitches straddling every outline, running stitches inside the shapes, and each layer casting a soft shadow on the one below.
styles.not: Not cut paper (no crisp edges, no hard drop shadow), not knitting, not embroidery on linen, not vector flat shapes; no gradients inside a piece, no gloss, no thin lines, no outline-only drawing.
styles.render: Ground: a cream felt sheet (#efe2c9) covered with 400-600 faint 6-16 px hairs at .04-.06 alpha, plus 8-12 broad lighter/darker patches at .05 so the sheet is not flat. Every felt piece is a FILLED shape in one flat #hex (wool has no sheen), its silhouette pushed through <filter><feTurbulence baseFrequency='.09' numOctaves='3'/><feDisplacementMap scale='6'/></filter> so no edge is die-cut. Around the edge, inside a clip made of the same path stroked 30 px, draw 150-250 random 6-16 px hairs in a 12-18 % lighter and darker tint of the piece at .3-.45 alpha: that is the fibre halo. Inside the piece clip, 80-140 tiny 3-8 px hairs at .1 make the wool. Under each piece put the same path translated 10-14 px down, filled rgba(30,24,20,.28) and blurred 9 px: a soft felt shadow, never a hard one. Attach every piece with BLANKET STITCH: sample the outline at 44-52 px steps, draw a 26-32 px bar centred on the edge, perpendicular to it, 6-7 px wide, round caps, in a contrasting thread (rust on cream, cream on dark green), plus a 2.4 px dashed thread (12 26) running along the same edge; a few pieces get a RUNNING STITCH seam instead (5 px dashed 26 18). Wool form is shown by 3-6 dashed stitch lines or 3-4 overlapping scalloped bumps, never by shading. Keep pieces big and flat: 6-8 felt colours, all matte, one deep umber for real dark.
styles.composition: A felt ram in profile filling the middle, made of scalloped wool bumps, charcoal head and legs, a rust spiral horn; three felt hills stacked behind it with stitched seams, a mustard felt sun disc, two felt tulips on a deep umber foreground band, the headline huge upper left with a stitched underline.
styles.colour: Felt palette: cream #f8f2e4 and oat ground #efe2c9, olive #6d7f4f and sage #8e9b6b hills, rust #b5502f with #8a3a22 shadow thread, mustard #dfa63f, charcoal #2f2a24, deep umber #241d17; thread is always a value step away from the felt, never a tint.
styles.type: Anton caps 170-195 px in charcoal, letterspaced 0.02 em, sitting on the felt like a cut patch; a small Inter Tight 500 caps line at .3 em under it, and a 5 px rust running stitch under the headline.
styles.motion: Hand-placed: each felt piece lands whole in 2 frames and settles 6-10 px with a soft bounce, one piece after another; the stitches are already on the piece as it lands. No fades on shapes, no scaling, no floating.
styles.camera: Locked flat lay; at most a 1.04 push or a 4 px drift as if the sheet were being smoothed by hand.
styles.transitions: A felt shape is laid over the frame and becomes the next ground; a blanket-stitch line runs across and pulls the next scene in; a shadow sweeps as a hand passes.
styles.sound: Soft and textile: scissors through felt, a needle pulling thread, a wool thump, a low frame drum, a quiet hum, fabric smoothed by hand.

tr.look: Keçe aplikasyon: yün keçeden kesilmiş kalın parçalar, tüylü kenarlar, kenarı kavrayan verev dikişler, içte yorgan dikişi, her katmanın altına yumuşak gölge.
tr.type: Anton büyük harf, keçe yama gibi; altında küçük aralıklı sans ve rust renkli teyel çizgisi.
tr.motion: Elle yerleştirilir: her parça iki karede bütün gelir, 6-10 px oturur; dikişler parçayla birlikte gelir.
tr.sound: Keçe makası, iğne-iplik, yün gümbürtüsü, alçak davul, kumaş düzeltme.
tr.avoid: Keskin kâğıt kenarı, sert gölge, parlama, gradyan, ince çizgi, örgü.

en.look: Felt appliqué: thick wool pieces with fuzzy fibre edges, blanket stitches straddling every outline, running stitches, a soft shadow under each layer.
en.type: Anton caps like a cut felt patch; a small tracked sans and a rust tacking line under it.
en.motion: Hand-placed: each piece lands whole in two frames, settles 6-10 px; its stitches arrive with it.
en.sound: Felt scissors, needle and thread, wool thump, low drum, fabric smoothed.
en.avoid: Crisp paper edges, hard shadows, gloss, gradients, thin lines, knitting.

styles.name: Hand embroidery
styles.essence: A motif sewn in thread on open linen: every shape built from individual satin stitches that lie side by side with a sheen, outlines in twisted stem stitch, a cross-stitch sampler band, the loose needle still threaded.
styles.not: Not a printed illustration, not felt appliqué, not cross-stitch pixels only, not smooth vector fills; no flat colour area without stitches, no gloss, no gradients, no soft airbrush shading.
styles.render: Ground: coarse linen, base #ded0b0, a 7 px SVG pattern with a 1.6 px horizontal weft line (#c9b995, .55), a 1.4 px vertical warp line (#f0e5cb, .5) and two 1 px offset threads, so the weave is visible under everything; a radial lighter patch at 30 % 25 % and darker corners. Each motif shape is filled by SATIN STITCH: 100-200 parallel strands at 9-11 px pitch, each 7-8 px thick, following the form (vertical on the fruit, 35 deg on the leaves, diagonal on the calyx), bowed 12-20 px so the stitch direction follows the volume; every strand is drawn three times: 2.4 px offset down-right in a 45 % darker thread, the main colour, and a 2 px offset up-left highlight at .4. Outlines and stems are STEM STITCH: a 8-10 px line with a 3 px lighter dash (13 9) alternating phase on top, so the thread looks twisted. Small seeds and knots are 30-40 px satin blobs with a gold highlight; the sampler band at the bottom is CROSS STITCH: 34 px X marks, each two 6 px strokes, alternating indigo/madder/gold on the linen. A real steel needle with an eye and a loose madder thread lies at the right. Never show a shape as flat fill.
styles.composition: A whole pomegranate with a five-point calyx and two leaves in the middle, a cut half in front showing ruby seed chambers and a cream membrane, a threaded needle at the right, a cross-stitch sampler band across the bottom, the headline upper left with a stitched rule under it.
styles.colour: Linen #ded0b0, madder #a3312b with deep #6e1e1c and bright #c4513c threads, olive #5a6b3a, pomegranate-seed gold #cf9a3a, indigo #2e4468, cream #efe3c6, stem brown #6b4a2f; thread colours stay close in value except the ruby seeds, which are the one saturated note.
styles.type: Cormorant Garamond 600 caps 150-168 px in deep madder, letterspaced 0.02 em, calm and sampler-like; a small Inter Tight 500 caps line at .3 em, with a 3 px stem-stitch rule between them.
styles.motion: Sewn on: the motif appears area by area, each area wiping in along its stitch direction in 0.2 s, then holds; the needle slides in last with the thread drawing behind it. No scaling of the finished motif, no floating.
styles.camera: Locked macro on the linen; at most a 1.05 push toward the fruit or a 3 px drift as if the hoop were being turned.
styles.transitions: A thread is pulled across the frame and becomes the next outline; a satin-stitch area wipes the scene in its stitch direction; the hoop edge passes the lens.
styles.sound: Textile and close: needle through linen, thread pulled with a soft zip, scissors, a low lute, a quiet room, fabric on a wooden table.

tr.look: Kanaviçe: keten üstünde ipekle işlenmiş nar; her yüzey yan yana saten dikişlerden, saplar burgulu sap işi, altta kanaviçe bordür, iğne hâlâ iplikli.
tr.type: Cormorant Garamond büyük harf, koyu kök kırmızısı; altında küçük aralıklı sans ve dikişli çizgi.
tr.motion: Dikilerek gelir: her alan kendi dikiş yönünde 0.2 sn'de sıvanır, sonra durur; iğne en son ipliğiyle girer.
tr.sound: Keten üstünde iğne, iplik çekişi, makas, alçak ud, sessiz oda.
tr.avoid: Düz vektör dolgu, parlama, gradyan, hava fırçası gölge, keçe, baskı.

en.look: Hand embroidery: a pomegranate sewn in silk on linen, every area side-by-side satin stitches, stems in twisted stem stitch, a cross-stitch band, the needle still threaded.
en.type: Cormorant Garamond caps in deep madder; a small tracked sans and a stitched rule.
en.motion: Sewn on: each area wipes in along its stitch direction in 0.2 s and holds; the needle enters last with its thread.
en.sound: Needle through linen, thread pulled, scissors, low lute, a quiet room.
en.avoid: Flat vector fills, gloss, gradients, airbrush shading, felt, print.

styles.name: Sand art on a light table
styles.essence: A drawing poured and finger-swept in dark sand on a glowing light table: granular silhouettes that break into individual grains at every edge, thin sand reading as translucent brown, finger-wiped lines showing the light through, loose grains scattered around the motif.
styles.not: Not an airbrushed silhouette, not ink, not a photograph of sand, not flat vector black; no crisp vector edge, no gloss, no hard shadow, no coloured paint, no smooth gradient inside the sand.
styles.render: Ground: the light table, a big radial gradient from #ffe9bd at 45 % 38 % through #e8a95a to #8a4a16 at the corners, plus a wide soft white glow behind the motif. Sand is ONE colour family: #2a1c11 for thick masses, #4a3420 for mid, #6d5236 where the sand is thin; the light does the rest. Every sand mass is a filled shape under <filter><feTurbulence baseFrequency='.05' numOctaves='3'/><feDisplacementMap scale='9'/></filter> so its contour is torn, then 200-300 2-5 px grains (a mix of the sand colour and a 40 % lighter tint) are clipped to a 30 px band around that contour, and 120 more inside at .15, so no edge is a line: it is grains. A blurred copy of the shape at 12-20 % sits behind it as the thin-sand halo. Finger marks are 8-16 px strokes with round caps in a 25 % lighter sand, and where a finger wiped the sand away the line is the glow colour (#ffe0aa); a thin sand line is a 3-5 px stroke with grains along it. Loose grains: 200-400 2-4 px dots clustered at the base and along the sweep, darker on the glow, lighter inside the masses. Keep the sand masses large and simple; detail comes from erased lines, not outlines.
styles.composition: A camel caravan in profile filling the middle: one big camel, hump, long curved neck and small head, thin legs, a blanket drawn with erased lines; a torn sand dune across the bottom third, a thin sand sun ring high right, three finger-drawn birds, the headline upper left in dark sand.
styles.colour: Light table amber #8a4a16 - #e8a95a - #ffe9bd, sand #2a1c11, mid sand #4a3420, thin sand #6d5236, erased line #ffe0aa; only warm amber and brown-black, no other hue, with real dark in every mass.
styles.type: Anton caps 150-165 px in dark sand brown, letterspaced 0.02 em, with a slightly soft edge as if swept; a small Inter Tight 500 caps line at .3 em in mid-brown under it.
styles.motion: Poured and swept: the dunes settle first, the camel mass fades up with a 2-3 px grain jitter, the finger lines draw on from one end over 0.25 s, grains scatter last. Nothing slides as a whole shape.
styles.camera: Locked top-down on the light table; at most a 1.05 push or a 3 px drift as if the table were nudged.
styles.transitions: A hand sweeps the sand off the frame and the next scene is revealed; a poured line becomes the next horizon; grains blow across and reform as the next subject.
styles.sound: Dry and intimate: sand poured, a palm sweeping the table, soft tabla, a low ney, a quiet room, grains falling.

tr.look: Işıklı masada kum: parlayan amber zemin üzerinde koyu kum kütleleri, her kenar tanelere ayrışır, parmakla sıvanmış çizgiler ışığı gösterir, etrafa dağılmış taneler.
tr.type: Anton büyük harf, koyu kum rengi, hafif yumuşak kenarlı; altında küçük aralıklı sans.
tr.motion: Dökülür ve sıvanır: kumullar önce oturur, deve taneli bir titreşimle belirir, parmak çizgileri bir uçtan çizilir, taneler en son dağılır.
tr.sound: Kum dökülüşü, avuç süpürmesi, yumuşak tabla, alçak ney, sessiz oda.
tr.avoid: Hava fırçası silüet, mürekkep, keskin vektör kenar, parlama, sert gölge, renkli boya.

en.look: Sand art on a light table: dark sand masses on glowing amber, every edge breaking into grains, finger-swept lines showing the light, loose grains scattered.
en.type: Anton caps in dark sand brown, softly edged; a small tracked sans beneath.
en.motion: Poured and swept: dunes settle first, the camel rises with a grain jitter, finger lines draw on from one end, grains scatter last.
en.sound: Sand poured, palm sweeping, soft tabla, low ney, a quiet room.
en.avoid: Airbrushed silhouettes, ink, crisp vector edges, gloss, hard shadows, coloured paint.

styles.name: Paper quilling
styles.essence: A picture built from narrow paper strips stood on edge: tight coils, loose spirals and marquise shapes packed side by side so every element shows its strip thickness, an inner spiral line and a soft shadow, forming one motif on a card.
styles.not: Not cut paper shapes, not rolled-paper tubes seen from the side, not flat vector circles, not embroidery or felt; no glossy plastic, no gradients inside a strip, no outline drawing, no thin lines that are not paper.
styles.render: Ground: a cream card (#f2e8d4) with a paper grain; the motif casts a soft grey shadow on it. Every quilled element is drawn as a STRIP SEEN ON EDGE: a disc of the strip colour, a 2-3 px darker rim (the strip's cut edge), an inner disc 2 px smaller offset up-left in the face colour, then the spiral: an Archimedean path from r*0.16 to r*0.86, 2-2.5 turns, stroke 2.2 in a 35 % darker tone at .75, so you see the wound strip. A 2.6 px white arc along the top-left at .45 is the paper sheen, never a gradient. Teardrops and marquises are the same disc pulled to a point. Shadows: all the coils of one band share ONE group shadow (a blurred copy translated 5-8 px down at 22-30 %), never a per-coil filter. Straight strips are rounded rectangles with a dark bottom edge and a 2 px white top line; a gore or a rope is one strip 8-14 px wide curving with the form, its shadow 3 px below. Pack coils so they touch and slightly overlap, sizes vary 26-40 px; 5-6 strip colours, each band one colour.
styles.composition: A Cappadocia hot-air balloon filling the middle: the envelope built of horizontal bands of coils in five colours, three curved gores of paper strip, four strip ropes down to a small basket of stacked strips, two quilled scroll clouds at the sides, the headline upper left in plum with a strip rule under it.
styles.colour: Card #f2e8d4, strip colours coral #d0705a, ochre #dfa53f, terracotta #bf5a38, teal #3f7d78, plum #6d3b56, cream strip #f0e4c8, cut edges #3a2a22; bands are flat colour, value steps between neighbours make the winding read.
styles.type: Anton caps 180-195 px in plum #4a2f45 with a 3 px cream strip shadow, like a paper cut-out; a small Inter Tight 500 caps line at .3 em in terracotta under it.
styles.motion: Wound on: each band of coils appears whole, band by band from the top down, with a 1.5 % overshoot and a 2 px settle; the ropes and basket drop in last; the clouds curl in. Nothing spins.
styles.camera: Locked flat lay on the card; at most a 1.04 push or a 3 px drift as if the card were turned.
styles.transitions: A strip curls across the frame and becomes the next outline; a coil unwinds and fills the frame; the card is lifted away.
styles.sound: Paper and close: strips sliding, a coil springing open, scissors, a soft kaval, a quiet room, a fingertip press.

tr.look: Kâğıt kıvırma: dar şeritler dikine durur; sıkı kangal, gevşek spiral ve damla biçimleri yan yana, her birinde şerit kalınlığı, iç spiral çizgisi ve yumuşak gölge.
tr.type: Anton büyük harf, erik rengi, kâğıt kesimi gibi; altında küçük aralıklı sans.
tr.motion: Sarılarak gelir: her kangal kuşağı bütün olarak üstten alta yerleşir, hafif oturur; ipler ve sepet en son iner.
tr.sound: Kâğıt şerit kayışı, kangal açılışı, makas, yumuşak kaval, sessiz oda.
tr.avoid: Düz vektör daire, parlak plastik, gradyan, kontur çizimi, keçe, nakış.

en.look: Paper quilling: narrow strips stood on edge, tight coils, loose spirals and marquises packed together, each showing strip thickness, an inner spiral and a soft shadow.
en.type: Anton caps in plum like a paper cut-out; a small tracked sans beneath.
en.motion: Wound on: each band of coils lands whole, top band first, with a slight settle; ropes and basket drop in last.
en.sound: Paper strips sliding, a coil springing, scissors, soft kaval, a quiet room.
en.avoid: Flat vector circles, glossy plastic, gradients, outline drawing, felt, embroidery.

styles.name: Origami
styles.essence: A model folded from one sheet: crisp straight creases, every plane a flat facet with its own light or shadow, the paper's grain visible, no curve and no outline that is not a fold.
styles.not: Not cut paper, not a 3D render with smooth shading, not a papercraft kit with printed texture, not low-poly CGI; no gradients across a facet, no rounded corners, no soft airbrush, no colour that is not the sheet.
styles.render: One warm paper, #f7f1e2, lit from the upper left. The subject is a set of POLYGONS that share edges exactly: each facet is one flat #hex from a 6-step ramp (#fbf6e9 lit, #f7f1e2, #e9dec6, #dbcfb6, #cbbda1, #b3a488 in shadow), assigned by which way the plane faces, never by a gradient. Every shared edge gets a CREASE: a 2.2 px line rgba(52,42,28,.24) on the shadow side and a 1.6 px #fff9e6 line at .3 offset 1.2 px up-left on the lit side, so each fold catches light. The silhouette gets a 3 px warm rim light at .45. A soft contact shadow (blurred ellipse at 40 %, 22 px) sits under the model; a blurred 8 px line along the base fold reads as the crease shadow. Background is two big paper planes split by one diagonal crease, #26342f and #1d2825, the same crease treatment, so the backdrop is folded paper too. Paper grain over all of it, and every edge dead straight: no curves, no double lines.
styles.composition: A single origami crane in three-quarter profile filling the middle, wing raised and fanned into three facets, long neck and pointed beak to the left, tail to the right, a soft contact shadow under the body; background split by one diagonal crease; the headline upper left in warm paper cream.
styles.colour: Paper cream #f7f1e2 with the facet ramp #fbf6e9 to #b3a488, background deep slate green #26342f and #1d2825, crease shadow #342a1e, rim light #fff9e6; one paper only, the whole image is value.
styles.type: Anton caps 185-200 px in paper cream #f2ebd8, letterspaced 0.02 em, dead flat like type cut from the same sheet; a small Inter Tight 500 caps line at .3 em in sage #a9b8a5.
styles.motion: Folded into place: each facet lands flat in 2 frames, the wing opens last by rotating 8-12 deg around its base crease and snapping to its rest angle; no scaling, no floating, no fade on the paper.
styles.camera: Locked orthographic three-quarter; at most a 1.04 push or a 2 px drift as if the sheet were being turned.
styles.transitions: A crease line runs across the frame and the paper folds over into the next scene; the sheet rotates once and is the next ground; the model unfolds flat and becomes a new sheet.
styles.sound: Paper and precise: a sheet unfolded, a sharp crease press, scissors nowhere, a soft koto or kanun, a quiet room.

tr.look: Origami: tek kâğıttan katlanmış turna; keskin düz katlar, her yüzey kendi ışığında düz bir facet, kâğıt dokusu görünür, eğri çizgi yok.
tr.type: Anton büyük harf, kâğıt kremi, aynı tabakadan kesilmiş gibi düz; altında küçük aralıklı sans.
tr.motion: Katlanarak gelir: her facet iki karede düz oturur, kanat en son 8-12 derece açılıp yerine oturur.
tr.sound: Kâğıt açılışı, keskin kat baskısı, yumuşak kanun, sessiz oda.
tr.avoid: Kesme kâğıt, yumuşak 3B gölge, gradyan, yuvarlak köşe, baskı deseni.

en.look: Origami: a crane folded from one sheet, crisp straight creases, every plane a flat facet with its own light, paper grain visible, no curve.
en.type: Anton caps in paper cream, flat as if cut from the same sheet; a small tracked sans beneath.
en.motion: Folded into place: each facet lands flat in two frames, the wing opens last by 8-12 deg and snaps to rest.
en.sound: Sheet unfolded, a sharp crease press, soft kanun, a quiet room.
en.avoid: Cut paper, soft 3D shading, gradients, rounded corners, printed patterns.

styles.name: Wood inlay marquetry
styles.essence: A picture made of thin wood veneers laid into one surface: every petal, leaf and frame member a different wood with its grain running its own way, tight dark joints between the pieces, and a varnished sheen lying over the whole panel.
styles.not: Not woodcut printing, not carved relief, not a painted picture on wood, not veneer photo texture; no drawn outlines standing in for joints, no grain that runs the same way in every piece, no flat graphic shapes, no matte surface.
styles.render: A single flat panel fills the frame. Frame members are four mitered trapezoids of walnut #5b3a26, grain along the member (horizontal on the top and bottom, vertical on the sides). The field is satinwood #c8a265, grain 3-5 deg off horizontal. Each motif piece is its own veneer: mahogany #7b3b26, rosewood #5f2b1e, light padauk #a85833, olive ash #6b6b3e and #55562c, ebony stem #3a2618. In every piece draw 18-30 wavy grain lines, clipped to the piece, at that piece's own angle (vertical in the petals, 40 deg in the leaves, along the frame), 2-4 px wide, one pass in a 45 % darker tint at .16 and one in a 35 % lighter tint at .1; add 20-40 1 px pores. JOINT: each piece is drawn over a copy of itself translated 2-4 px down-right in near-black, then outlined 2.5-3 px in rgba(30,18,10,.6), so neighbouring veneers are separated by a tight dark seam, with a 1.2 px light bevel at .25 up-left. The varnish is the last layer: a warm 20 % highlight from the top-left, two blurred diagonal specular streaks at .05-.07 and a 25 % vignette, so the panel looks polished. No drawn contour lines beyond the joints.
styles.composition: One large tulip with a stem, two long leaves and a bud in the middle of a light satinwood field, framed by a thick walnut border with mitered corners and a double ebony-and-maple stringing line, the headline upper left in dark walnut, a small wood-name line under it.
styles.colour: Satinwood #c8a265 field, walnut #5b3a26 frame, mahogany #7b3b26 and rosewood #5f2b1e petals, padauk #a85833 highlight petal, olive ash #6b6b3e and #55562c leaves, ebony #3a2618 stem and stringing; all warm browns with real near-black in the joints, no other hue.
styles.type: Anton caps 190-205 px in dark walnut #2a170c, letterspaced 0.02 em, flat like an inlaid letter; a small Inter Tight 500 caps line at .3 em in mid walnut under it.
styles.motion: Laid in: pieces appear whole in 2 frames, petal by petal and leaf by leaf, with a 1 px settle as if pressed into the bed; the varnish sheen travels once across the finished panel. Nothing scales or floats.
styles.camera: Locked flat-on to the panel; at most a 1.05 push toward the flower or a 3 px drift as if the panel were tilted to the light.
styles.transitions: A veneer piece slides in and becomes the next field; the sheen sweeps across and the next scene is under it; the frame closes in from the edges.
styles.sound: Wood and workshop: a veneer sheet lifted, a scalpel on wood, a press, a low kanun, a brush of varnish, a quiet room.

tr.motion: Yerleştirilir: parçalar iki karede bütün gelir, taç yaprak yaprak, 1 px oturur; vernik parlaklığı en son bir kez geçer.

en.type: Anton caps in dark walnut, flat like an inlaid letter; a small tracked sans beneath.

styles.name: Low-poly render
styles.essence: A faceted 3D mesh: every surface is broken into visible triangles, each one filled flat with its own value, so a single hard light from the upper left builds the whole picture out of facets - no gradient, no outline, no smooth curve.
styles.not: Not flat vector, not a papercraft cut-out, not a smooth 3D render with soft shading, not a wireframe; no gradients, no blur, no texture detail inside a facet, no round un-faceted shapes, no neon.
styles.render: Build every object as a triangulated surface in 3D coordinates (x, y, z) and project it orthographically: a rock is a ring stack of 10-12 vertices at 6-8 heights, a balloon an ellipsoid of 8 gores, the ground a jittered grid split into triangles. For each triangle compute its outward normal, N, and fill it with ONE flat colour: face = tint x (0.42 + 0.72 x max(0, N.L)), with L the light direction normalised (-0.46, -0.62, 0.63) in screen space (x right, y down, z toward viewer); flip a normal that points inward. Sort the faces by the z of their centroid and paint far to near. Every polygon carries stroke equal to its own fill at 0.6 px so no AA seam shows. Palette is per material, not per object: rock #d69660 in five values, ground #5b3b3d to #241a28, sky in four warm-to-cold bands made of big triangles; never add a gradient. The silhouette must stay angular: nothing curved, and the facets on the subject are 50-120 px wide so they read at phone size.
styles.composition: Cappadocia valley at dusk: one tall fairy chimney on the centre axis, a shorter one left and one right, a faceted sun low left and a tiny hot-air balloon high right; a triangulated ground plane in the lower third and a jagged ridge behind; headline above the chimneys.
styles.colour: Dusk sky #141a34 -> #3a2f5c -> #8a4a66 -> #d9825f at the horizon; rock #d69660 with shadow #6a3b2a and lit #f4cd97; ground #5b3b3d / #35242c; balloon red #e8503f with cream #f2c46a and teal #3f7d8c; every value flat, the darkest facet near black and the lightest near white.
styles.type: Anton caps 120-135 px in warm cream #f6e3c8, tight, sitting on the sky; Inter Tight 500 caps at 26 px, tracked 0.32 em, in a pale sand tone beneath; no shadow, no outline.
styles.motion: Built in layers: the ground settles, each rock rises 90 px into place as one mesh, the balloon drifts up 40 px, the sun scales 0.86 -> 1; everything arrives in 0.5 s power2.out steps and is still by 2.2 s. Nothing rotates or wobbles.
styles.camera: Locked orthographic; at most a 1.05 push toward the tall chimney, or a 12 px vertical drift as if the camera settled on its tripod.
styles.transitions: The front facets of the rock open like a fan into the next frame; a hard triangulated wipe of three big polygons; the balloon rises out of frame and cuts.
styles.sound: Wind over tuff, a low drone, a balloon burner roar and a distant dog; sparse, dry, no music bed.

tr.look: Low-poly mesh: her yüzey görünür üçgenlere bölünmüş, her üçgen tek düz renkle, sert bir üst-sol ışıkla; Kapadokya peribacaları, balon ve ufuk.
tr.type: Anton sıcak krem büyük harf, gökyüzüne oturur; altında ince aralıklı sans satır.
tr.motion: Katman katman kurulur: zemin oturur, kayalar 90 px yükselip yerleşir, balon süzülür, güneş büyür; 2,2 s'de her şey durur.
tr.sound: Tüf üstünde rüzgâr, alçak drone, balon brülörü, uzak köpek.
tr.avoid: Düz vektör, kâğıt kesme, yumuşak gölgeli 3D, tel kafes, gradyan, bulanıklık, neon.

styles.name: Vinyl toy
styles.essence: A designer vinyl figure on a seamless studio backdrop: soft matte-plastic colour under one big softbox, a few hard specular spots, an over-large head with simple features, mould seams, and a quiet contact shadow - the object is a toy, and the picture is a product photograph of it.
styles.not: Not 3D-rendered clay, not a cartoon illustration with outlines, not a plush toy, not a photo with props or hands; no flat vector fills, no dark background, no harsh spotlights, no logos, no more than one figure.
styles.render: Soft plastic = a body built from radial CSS/SVG gradients, never a flat fill: every part is a <radialGradient> whose light centre sits at 34 % / 24 % of the shape (#fff0cf -> #f7c47f -> #d98f4e -> #b06a36), so the form turns away from the light on its lower right. On top of that, specular highlights: one big 70-90 px white ellipse at 45 % opacity with an feGaussianBlur of 8 (the softbox), one 20-30 px hard white ellipse at 90 % opacity (the reflection), and a 3 px white stroke at 55 % only along the upper-left contour (the rim). Darken where forms meet with a blurred #7a3f1e ellipse at 30-40 % (ambient occlusion at the neck, armpits, under the head, under the feet), so parts sit on each other instead of merging. Surfaces are silky smooth and slightly satin: no texture inside a shape, one thin darker mould seam down the crown of the head. Backdrop is a seamless cyclorama: a radial gradient #e6f7f2 -> #a8dcd4 -> #6cb8b1 with the floor a separate soft vertical gradient; a 300 x 60 px blurred contact shadow under the feet and a warm bounce on the shadow side. Keep the silhouette chunky and simple: a head 44 % of the figure's height, ears as separate balls, arms and legs as capsules with round paws.
styles.composition: One figure dead centre on a seamless mint studio sweep: the big head on the upper third, small body beneath, feet planted on a soft shadow; the headline high above it in deep teal and a product line under the headline; nothing else in the frame.
styles.colour: Mint studio #e6f7f2 / #a8dcd4 / #6cb8b1, toy amber #f7c47f with shadow #b06a36 and cream #fff0cf, rosette brown #5e3320, muzzle cream #fff6e6, eye near-black #1a100b, one accent coral #ef6f5a for the inner ear and the toy's bead, deep teal type #134a48.
styles.type: Poppins 700 caps 92-100 px in deep teal, tracked 0.02 em, with a small Inter Tight 500 caps line at 26 px, tracked 0.3 em, under it; text is centred and never on the figure.
styles.motion: A toy placed on a table: the figure pops in from 0.86 with a gentle back.out and settles in 0.55 s, the softbox highlight slides 20 px across the head once, the bead swings 8 degrees and stops; the type fades up 18 px. No rotation, no bounce after settling.
styles.camera: Locked product frame; a very slow 1.04 push toward the face, or a 10 px rise from the feet to the eyes.
styles.transitions: A soft light sweep crosses the set and cuts; the figure turns away out of frame; a shallow-focus pull to the next subject.
styles.sound: Studio quiet: a soft plastic squeak, a box lid, a soft thud as the figure lands, a low airy pad.

tr.look: Tasarım vinil oyuncak: dikişsiz mint stüdyo zemininde yumuşak plastik gövde, büyük kafa, basit yüz, sert speküler parlamalar, yumuşak temas gölgesi.

styles.name: Frosted glass
styles.essence: Glassmorphism as a place: a stack of translucent frosted panels floating over soft colour blobs, each panel with a bright 1 px lit edge, a blurred world seen through it and a sharp engraved scene on its face - depth comes from layers, not from perspective.
styles.not: Not a flat UI mockup, not a dashboard with charts, not glossy plastic, not a photograph of real glass; no hard black, no flat opaque cards, no drop-shadow-only depth, no icon set, no more than three panels.
styles.render: Two glass recipes only. The ground is dark #061621 with 4-5 oversized radial-gradient blobs (#ff7a45, #ff3d81, #17c3b2, #3d5afe) and a sharp repeating-linear-gradient of 2 px white lines at 115 deg, 26 px apart - the lines are the proof of frost: crisp outside a panel, smeared to nothing behind it. A panel is a div at 8-18 % white with border-radius 40 px, border 1 px rgba(255,255,255,.5), backdrop-filter: blur(30px) saturate(160%), and an inset light: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.75), inset 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,.25), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.1), 0 30px 70px rgba(0,10,20,.5); one diagonal linear-gradient sheen at 12 % crosses the top-left half. Depth is a back panel rotated -3 deg behind the front one, plus one small chip floating on top, each with its own blur. The scene on the front panel is drawn sharp in 3 px white at .8-.95 alpha with a 14 px cyan glow: a suspension bridge, its cables sagging between two towers, water lines under the deck, all in white line so it reads as etched on the glass, never as a photo.
styles.composition: Portrait stage: frosted head above, a big panel across the middle holding an etched Bosphorus bridge and a pale sun behind it, a back panel offset behind at -3 deg, two small glass chips on the front panel; the headline on the dark ground above the glass, a tracked line under it.
styles.colour: Deep night #061621, orange blob #ff7a45, magenta #ff3d81, teal #17c3b2, blue #3d5afe, glass white #f2fbff at 8-18 %, frosted highlights #ffffff, etched line #eaf8ff; the colours only ever appear blurred through glass, never as flat fills.
styles.type: Inter Tight 800 caps 150 px in #f2fbff for the headline with 0.01 em tracking; Inter Tight 500 caps 26 px tracked 0.34 em in #bfeef0 for the line beneath; chip labels in Inter Tight 500 at 24 px, white at .85.
styles.motion: Layers settle: the back panel rises 30 px and stops, the front panel follows 0.12 s later, the etched bridge fades in line by line, the blobs drift 30 px over the whole shot, the chip slides 16 px. Slow, weightless, nothing rotates after landing, all still by 2.3 s.
styles.camera: Locked frontal; a 1.04 push into the bridge through the glass, or a slow 20 px parallax between the panels.
styles.transitions: A panel slides across and becomes the next frame; the frost clears to sharp; a light sweep crosses all layers at once.
styles.sound: Clean and airy: a soft glass chime, a low pad, a bridge cable hum, water far below, one muted click as the chip lands.

tr.look: Buzlu cam: koyu zemin üzerinde renk lekeleri, üst üste yarı saydam buzlu paneller, 1 px ışıklı kenarlar, panelde kazınmış gibi Boğaz köprüsü; derinlik katmanlardan.

en.type: Inter Tight heavy white caps; a thin tracked cyan line beneath.

en.sound: Glass chime, low pad, bridge-cable hum, water far below, one soft click.

styles.name: Cyberpunk street
styles.essence: A narrow, rain-soaked street at two in the morning: shutters and pipes in dirty near-black, Turkish neon signs buzzing in magenta, cyan and sodium orange, steam hanging in the air, and every light repeated and broken in the wet asphalt - a real place, not a grid.
styles.not: Not synthwave (no grid floor, no sun, no mountains, no chrome type), not anime, not a clean futuristic city, not daylight, not a game HUD; no flat vector buildings, no bright saturated sky, no legible brand logos, no tidy symmetry.
styles.render: One-point perspective: the alley's vanishing point at (540, 1080); the left wall is the quad (0,300)-(350,540)-(350,1080)-(0,1360) and the right wall mirrors it, so every window is a perspective quad placed by a (u, v) grid on that wall (u = depth, v = height). Walls are #0b0812 with window fills picked from #0a070f, warm #ffcf7a, cyan #7ef0ff and magenta #ff5ec4; about one window in four is lit and each lit one gets a 12 px blur copy. Neon is built in three layers: a 10 px blurred stroke at 35 %, a 5 px stroke of the pure colour, and a 2 px near-white core, all with stdDeviation 8; signs are dark boxes with a 2 px neon tube border and Turkish text (ÇAY, SİMİT, KOKOREÇ). Wet ground: the whole city group is mirrored about y = 1080 (`transform='translate(0,2160) scale(1,-1)'`), clipped to y 1080-1620, blurred 7 px, at 40 % and faded out by a vertical gradient, then broken by 20 horizontal ripple dashes and 6 elliptical puddle gradients in the signs' own colours. Rain: 70 thin 1.5 px streaks at 12 deg from vertical, white-blue at .10-.28, plus a slow fall tween; haze is 3 huge radial gradients (#ff2d95, #26e0ff, sodium #ff9b3d) at .18-.3. Keep the darks dirty: #06040c ground, #120a18 walls, never pure black blocks.
styles.composition: Looking down an alley: neon ÇAY sign on the left wall, SİMİT on the right, KOKOREÇ low on the left, a lit doorway at the far end on the vanishing point, one figure with an umbrella small in the lower middle, the wet street filling the bottom third with the signs repeated in it; headline in the sky gap above the alley.
styles.colour: Night #06040c, wall #120a18, wet asphalt #0a0710, magenta #ff2d95, cyan #26e0ff, sodium orange #ff9b3d, dirty teal #14424a, sign white #f4fbff; each glow is the same hue as its tube, and the darks stay brown-violet rather than black.
styles.type: Anton caps 140-160 px in #f4fbff with a 3 px magenta shadow to the left and a 3 px cyan shadow to the right (a tube mis-registration, not a gradient); Inter Tight 500 caps 27 px tracked 0.3 em in cyan for the place line; the neon signs use Poppins 700 in their own colour.
styles.motion: Rain never stops: streaks fall 1.2 screen-heights over 2.2 s, the neon buzzes with two 0.06 s flickers, steam drifts 24 px sideways, reflections shiver by 2-3 px, the figure shifts its weight once under the umbrella. No camera move except a 1.03 push; nothing pops in.
styles.camera: Locked at eye level on the vanishing point; a slow 1.03 push down the alley, or a 14 px handheld drift with a 2 px roll.
styles.transitions: A sheet of rain crosses the lens and wipes to the next scene; the neon flickers out and the frame cuts on the dark; a reflection stretches and becomes the next image.
styles.sound: Rain on metal awnings, a sign transformer buzz, a distant tram, water in a drain, one motorcycle far off, a low sub drone.

tr.look: Yağmurlu neon sokak: tek kaçış noktalı dar ara sokak, Türkçe neon tabelalar (ÇAY, SİMİT, KOKOREÇ), ıslak asfaltta kırılan yansımalar, buhar ve kirli karanlıklar.
tr.type: Anton beyaz büyük harf, iki yana kaçmış macenta/camgöbeği gölge; altında ince aralıklı camgöbeği satır.
tr.motion: Yağmur hiç durmaz, neon iki kez titreşir, buhar kayar, yansımalar 2-3 px titrer, figür bir kez ağırlığını kaydırır; kamera neredeyse sabit.
tr.sound: Tenekede yağmur, trafo uğultusu, uzak tramvay, lağımda su, uzak motosiklet, alçak bas.
tr.avoid: Synthwave ızgara, güneş, dağ, krom yazı, anime, temiz fütüristik şehir, gündüz, oyun HUD'u, marka logosu.

en.look: Rain-soaked neon alley: one-point perspective, Turkish neon signs (ÇAY, SİMİT, KOKOREÇ), reflections breaking in wet asphalt, steam and dirty near-blacks.
en.type: Anton white caps with a magenta and cyan shadow pulled sideways; a thin tracked cyan line below.
en.motion: Rain never stops, the neon flickers twice, steam drifts, reflections shiver 2-3 px, the figure shifts its weight once; the camera is almost still.
en.sound: Rain on tin, transformer buzz, a distant tram, water in a drain, a far motorcycle, a low sub.
en.avoid: Synthwave grid, sun, mountains, chrome type, anime, clean futurism, daylight, game HUDs, brand logos.

styles.name: Gothic illumination
styles.essence: A cathedral chancel at night: pointed arches stacked on pointed arches, rib vaults disappearing into black, a rose window burning cold above an altar of candles, and everything modelled by one warm candle and one cold window - stone in chiaroscuro, with a drawn blackletter initial as the sign of the script.
styles.not: Not a fantasy castle, not a Halloween scene, not a flat stained-glass poster, not a bright tourist photo; no neon, no daylight, no symmetrical flat colour fields, no rounded Romanesque arches, no modern props, no legible Bible text.
styles.render: Darkness is the ground: #070504 at the corners, stone only where a light touches it. Stone is 3-4 flat values (#2a2019 shadow, #3a2c21, #4a3828, #6b5038 lit, #a07a4e on a worn edge) laid as facet bands, never a smooth gradient; every arch is pointed, built from two quadratic arcs meeting at an apex (M x1 y0 Q x1 y1 apex), mouldings 18-40 px thick with a 2 px warm highlight on the light side. The rose window is a 12-fold wheel at (540, 720), r 232: a stone ring, 12 radial mullions 12 px wide, a ring of 12 trefoil circles at r 150, glass wedges alternating #1d2c5c, #5e1c20, #a86a28, #1f4340, all under a radial #ffcf7a -> #a85a20 glow, so it reads as backlit glass. Candlelight: each flame is a 3 px teardrop with three stacked radial gradients (#fff6d8, #ffcf7a at .5, #ff9b3d at 0) 120-260 px wide, and a blurred #ff9b3d ellipse under it; cast light is a warm radial gradient pooled on the stone, with the stone facets nearest the flame 3 values lighter. Chiaroscuro means the top third and outer edges go to near-black (a CSS radial vignette at 70 %), while the altar and the candle bases carry the only bright values. Blackletter accent: a drawn capital K of thick vertical strokes, diamond serifs and angular broken arms, gold #d8b06a with a dark outline, as an illuminated initial beside the headline - no blackletter font exists, so it is drawn.
styles.composition: Dead-centre chancel: the rose window on the axis at the upper third, a triple lancet and a candle altar beneath it, clustered piers left and right, rib vault lines converging above, two tall candle stands flanking the altar, one censer hanging off-axis at the left; the headline and its drawn blackletter initial across the top, the place line under it.
styles.colour: Near-black #070504, stone #2a2019 / #3a2c21 / #4a3828, lit stone #6b5038 and #a07a4e, gold #c9a063 / #e9cd95, glass blue #1d2c5c, oxblood #5e1c20, amber #a86a28, candle #ffcf7a and #ff9b3d; no colour outside candle-warm and window-cold.
styles.type: Cormorant Garamond 700 caps 128 px, tracked 0.08 em, in gold #e9cd95, preceded by a drawn blackletter K (gold strokes, diamond serifs) as an illuminated initial; Inter Tight 500 caps 27 px tracked 0.34 em in #b99a6b for the line beneath. No sans headline.
styles.motion: Candlelight moves, stone does not: flames flicker on 0.18 s sines with different phases, the censer swings 3 degrees and settles, the window glow pulses once, the altar light breathes; the type is simply present by 0.8 s. No camera move.
styles.camera: Locked on the axis, slightly low; at most a 1.03 push toward the rose, or a 20 px tilt up the vault.
styles.transitions: A candle flame grows and swallows the frame; the rose window's spokes rotate into the next scene; the image falls to black except one candle.
styles.sound: Stone room tone, a low choir drone, candle wicks, a censer chain, a distant bell, a single high boy's voice.

tr.look: Gotik katedral şanseli: sivri kemerler, kaburgalı tonoz, gül pencere, mum ışığıyla chiaroscuro; altınla çizilmiş bir blackletter K baş harfi.
tr.type: Cormorant Garamond kalın altın büyük harf, çizilmiş blackletter K ile; altında ince aralıklı toprak tonu satır.
tr.motion: Taş durur, mum oynar: alevler farklı fazlarda titrer, buhurdan 3 derece salınır, pencere bir kez nabız atar.
tr.sound: Taş oda tonu, alçak koro, mum fitilleri, buhurdan zinciri, uzak çan, tek yüksek çocuk sesi.
tr.avoid: Fantezi şato, Halloween, düz vitray afiş, parlak turistik fotoğraf, neon, gündüz, yuvarlak Roman kemeri.

en.look: Gothic cathedral chancel: pointed arches, rib vault, rose window, candlelight chiaroscuro, a drawn gold blackletter K initial.
en.type: Cormorant Garamond bold gold caps with the drawn blackletter K; a thin tracked earth-tone line below.
en.motion: Stone is still, candlelight moves: flames flicker in phases, the censer swings 3 degrees, the window pulses once.
en.sound: Stone room tone, a low choir, candle wicks, a censer chain, a distant bell, one high boy's voice.
en.avoid: Fantasy castles, Halloween, flat stained-glass posters, bright tourist photos, neon, daylight, round Roman arches.

styles.name: Terracotta relief
styles.essence: A fired-clay frieze panel lit hard from the side: figures modelled in low relief, every raised edge catching a warm highlight and dropping a soft cast shadow to the lower right, the slab chipped at the corners, its surface pitted and cracked, the colour of cooked earth from orange-buff to deep red-brown.
styles.not: Not a flat illustration or a vector icon, not stone or bronze, not glazed ceramic (no shine), not a museum photo of a real artefact; no gradients that read as paint, no modern symbols, no smooth plastic surfaces, no cool colours.
styles.render: One slab of clay: a polygon of 5-7 px jitter on every edge (a feTurbulence + feDisplacementMap at scale 7 roughens the outline), filled with a 135 deg gradient #d68a5a -> #b4683f -> #8f4a2b, then mottled with 3 large #7a3a20 radial patches at .12, 240 pitted dots (1-4 px, half darker #5e2a15, half lighter #e0a077) clipped to the slab, and 2-3 hairline cracks with a light lower lip. Every raised form is built the same way: a dark #5a2412 copy of its path translated (11, 14) and blurred 3 px (the cast shadow), the form itself in a 135 deg clay gradient, a 2.5-3 px #e6a97e stroke on its upper-left edge (the lit bevel) and a 2 px #6e3018 stroke on its lower-right edge. Legs, antlers and stems are strokes: a wider dark offset, the clay stroke at 14-22 px, a 2 px light edge. The border is a raised band 34 px deep with stamped triangles cut into it (dark fill, light bottom lip). The frieze itself: a rayed sun disc, two stags facing it, a zig-zag register and a row of bosses - all raised, no outlines, and the slab's own cast shadow falls on the dark wall behind it.
styles.composition: A portrait slab centred in the frame, its border band and inscription across the top, the rayed sun disc in the middle of the field with a stag on either side facing it, a zig-zag register and bosses along the bottom; the headline carved into the clay above the frieze, a small line beneath it.
styles.colour: Clay #d68a5a lit, #b4683f mid, #8f4a2b shadow, #5a2412 cast shadow and incision, #e6a97e bevel highlight, #f0d2b4 slip for the letters; nothing outside fired earth except the near-black background #1a0f0b.
styles.type: Cormorant Garamond 700 caps 92 px in warm slip #f7e7cf with a hard 3 px #6e3018 shadow down-right and a 1 px #f0c39a highlight up-left, so the letters read as pressed into the clay; Inter Tight 500 caps 26 px tracked 0.3 em in #f0d2b4 beneath.
styles.motion: Lit, not animated: a slow raking light travels across the relief once (1.5 s) and the carving seems to deepen; the slab itself is static. At most a 1.03 push; no element flies in.
styles.camera: Locked frontal, very slightly above the slab; a slow 8 px lateral drift so the relief's shadows move against the wall.
styles.transitions: The raking light crosses and cuts; a crack opens across the slab and becomes the next cut; the slab turns edge-on into a dark wall.
styles.sound: Dry clay: a fingertip on terracotta, a low warm drone, a single struck clay drum, a chisel tap, wind outside a dig house.

tr.look: Pişmiş toprak rölyef: yandan sert ışıkla kabartma figürler, her kabarık kenarda sıcak vurgu ve sağ altına düşen gölge, çatlak ve kırık köşeli levha, pişmiş toprak rengi.
tr.type: Cormorant kalın, kile bastırılmış gibi koyu gölgeli ve açık üst kenarlı; altında ince aralıklı toprak tonu satır.
tr.motion: Işıkla canlanır: tek bir yandan ışık levhanın üzerinden geçer, gölgeler 4 px uzayıp kısalır; levha hareketsiz.
tr.sound: Kuru kil: parmak terrakotada, alçak sıcak drone, tek vurmalı kil davul, keski tıkırtısı, kazı evinin dışında rüzgâr.
tr.avoid: Düz illüstrasyon, taş veya bronz, sırlı seramik, müze fotoğrafı, soğuk renk, modern sembol.

en.look: Fired-clay relief: side-lit raised figures, warm bevel highlights and cast shadows to the lower right, chipped slab, pitted surface, terracotta colour.
en.type: Cormorant bold, pressed into the clay with a dark lower-right shadow and a light upper-left lip; a thin tracked earth-tone line below.
en.motion: Lit, not animated: one raking light crosses the slab, shadows stretch 4 px; the slab is still.
en.sound: Dry clay: a fingertip on terracotta, a low warm drone, one struck clay drum, a chisel tap, wind outside.
en.avoid: Flat illustration, stone or bronze, glazed ceramic, museum photos, cool colours, modern symbols.
